回答模型对照与评分复核

32题 × 两个模型；同一份 MinerU＋千问检索证据、引用编号及原图。外部评委仅 Jev，最终以 Codex 对照原文复核为准。原始评分完整保留。

口径说明：Jev原始分沿用文字引用协议；Codex最终分同时核查该引用编号下实际交付的原图，不能用库里存在但当时未交付的图片补证据。要点和边界准则保持原样。两侧统一适用。

PFI Refining\n[原文]\nCommercial bleached softwood and hardwood kraft pulp fibers were obtained from Zhongzhirenhe Company (Jinan, Shandong Province, China). Two pulp were treated with a PFI refiner (Hamjern Maskin A/S, Hamar, Norway) according to Tappi T248 wd-97, with a pulp consistency of 10%, the gap between the opposite refining plates was 0.2 mm, and forces per bar length were 3.33 N/mm and 1.77 N/mm for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers, respectively. The drainability was characterized by the Schopper Riegler number (SR-number) with the standards ISO 5267-1. Two pulp fibers were separately refined in a PFI refiner at 0, 4000, 8000, 12,000, and 16,000 revolutions and at 0, 4000, 8000, 12,000, and 16,000 revolutions, respectively. Corresponding various pulps with an increasing beating degree, such as 16, 20, 40, 63, and 79<sup>◦</sup> SR, were obtained for softwood fibers and 0, 26, 40, 57, and 70<sup>◦</sup> SR were obtained for hardwood fibers.",

    "text": "[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 2. Methods > 2.1. PFI Refining\n[原文]\nCommercial bleached softwood and hardwood kraft pulp fibers were obtained from Zhongzhirenhe Company (Jinan, Shandong Province, China). Two pulp were treated with a PFI refiner (Hamjern Maskin A/S, Hamar, Norway) according to Tappi T248 wd-97, with a pulp consistency of 10%, the gap between the opposite refining plates was 0.2 mm, and forces per bar length were 3.33 N/mm and 1.77 N/mm for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers, respectively. The drainability was characterized by the Schopper Riegler number (SR-number) with the standards ISO 5267-1. Two pulp fibers were separately refined in a PFI refiner at 0, 4000, 8000, 12,000, and 16,000 revolutions and at 0, 4000, 8000, 12,000, and 16,000 revolutions, respectively. Corresponding various pulps with an increasing beating degree, such as 16, 20, 40, 63, and 79<sup>◦</sup> SR, were obtained for softwood fibers and 0, 26, 40, 57, and 70<sup>◦</sup> SR were obtained for hardwood fibers.",

    "text": "[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 2. Methods > 2.1. PFI Refining\n[原文]\nCommercial bleached softwood and hardwood kraft pulp fibers were obtained from Zhongzhirenhe Company (Jinan, Shandong Province, China). Two pulp were treated with a PFI refiner (Hamjern Maskin A/S, Hamar, Norway) according to Tappi T248 wd-97, with a pulp consistency of 10%, the gap between the opposite refining plates was 0.2 mm, and forces per bar length were 3.33 N/mm and 1.77 N/mm for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers, respectively. The drainability was characterized by the Schopper Riegler number (SR-number) with the standards ISO 5267-1. Two pulp fibers were separately refined in a PFI refiner at 0, 4000, 8000, 12,000, and 16,000 revolutions and at 0, 4000, 8000, 12,000, and 16,000 revolutions, respectively. Corresponding various pulps with an increasing beating degree, such as 16, 20, 40, 63, and 79<sup>◦</sup> SR, were obtained for softwood fibers and 0, 26, 40, 57, and 70<sup>◦</sup> SR were obtained for hardwood fibers.",

PFI2-004 · PFI打到12000转的时候，针叶木浆和阔叶木浆的打浆度各是多少？那我们以后想要63 °SR左右的浆，是不是直接打12000转就行了？

参考答案与评分要点
方法部分给出的12000转对应针叶木63 °SR、阔叶木57 °SR。相同转数在本文不同浆种/条件下得到的打浆度不同，不能据此建立适用于所有纸浆的唯一换算。两类浆的作用力也不同，不能把差异全部归因于浆种。

GPT-6 Astra · High

在该研究的PFI条件下，12000转时针叶木浆的打浆度为约63 °SR。 [1]
在相同研究条件下，12000转时阔叶木浆的打浆度为约57 °SR。 [1]
因此，若目标是约63 °SR，针叶木浆在该研究条件下可参考12000转，但阔叶木浆直接打12000转只能得到约57 °SR，不能将12000转视为通用设定。 [1]

要点：Jev 83.33% → 最终 83.33%；边界 2/2。

复核结论：63/57 °SR与转数映射正确，也说明12000转不能通用；未明确把不同作用力纳入限制，因此P3只给0.5。

Two pulp were treated with a PFI refiner (Hamjern Maskin A/S, Hamar, Norway) according to Tappi T248 wd-97, with a pulp consistency of 10%, the gap between the opposite refining plates was 0.2 mm, and forces per bar length were 3.33 N/mm and 1.77 N/mm for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers, respectively. The drainability was characterized by the Schopper Riegler number (SR-number) with the standards ISO 5267-1. DeepSeek Flash · High

按文中0、4000、8000、12000、16000转对应的打浆度序列，12000转时针叶木浆为63 °SR。 [1]
同一条件下，12000转时阔叶木浆为57 °SR。 [1]
因此想要约63 °SR的浆，不能对针叶木浆和阔叶木浆都直接固定打12000转；针叶木浆在12000转可达63 °SR，而阔叶木浆在12000转仅57 °SR，需要提高转数。 [1]
原文只给出阔叶木浆12000转为57 °SR、16000转为70 °SR，未给出达到63 °SR所需的确切转数，且这些数值仅适用于该文的浆料与PFI条件。 [1]

要点：Jev 83.33% → 最终 83.33%；边界 2/2。

复核结论：63/57 °SR与转数映射正确，也说明12000转不能通用；未明确把不同作用力纳入限制，因此P3只给0.5。

PFI2-006 · WRV在本文中如何测定和计算？请解释公式中两个质量的含义。

参考答案与评分要点
按ISO 23714使用0.5 g绝干样品测定。WRV=(m1−m2)/m2×100%，m1为离心后样品质量，m2为烘干样品质量。

GPT-6 Astra · High

本文取0.5 g绝干（o.d.）样品，按照ISO 23714测定WRV。 [2]
计算公式为：WRV（%）＝(m₁－m₂)/m₂ × 100%。 [1] [2]
m₁是样品离心后的质量；m₂是样品烘干后的质量。两者之差是离心后样品相对于烘干状态多出的质量，公式将其以烘干质量为基准换算为百分比。 [2]

要点：Jev 100.00% → 最终 100.00%；边界 2/2。

复核结论：0.5 g绝干、ISO 23714、WRV公式和质量定义均正确；按每个引用自身的具体贡献检查，而不要求每条引用独立证明整句。

DeepSeek Flash · High

WRV 按 ISO 23714 测定，所用试样为 0.5 g（o.d.，绝干计）。 [2]
WRV 的计算公式为 WRV(%) = (m1 − m2)/m2 × 100%。 [1]
公式中的 m1 是离心后试样的质量（即含水试样质量）。 [2]
公式中的 m2 是烘干试样的质量（绝干质量）。 [2]
m1 与 m2 之差对应试样经离心后仍保持的水的质量，因此该比值表示每单位绝干质量所保持的水量。 [1] [2]

要点：Jev 100.00% → 最终 100.00%；边界 2/2。

复核结论：0.5 g绝干、ISO 23714、WRV公式和质量定义均正确；按每个引用自身的具体贡献检查，而不要求每条引用独立证明整句。

PFI2-007 · CI-XI与CI-XA有什么区别？请给出本文CI-XI的公式，并说明CI-XA依据什么计算。

参考答案与评分要点
CI-XI用衍射峰强度计算：(I200−Iam)/I200×100%。CI-XA用晶区峰面积占总衍射面积的百分比计算，来自峰拟合。两者采用不同口径。

DeepSeek Flash · High

本文中两类CI值分别由峰强度法（CI-XI）和峰拟合（CI-XA）获得。 [2]
本文CI-XI的计算公式为 CI-XI = (I200 − Iam)/I200 × 100%。 [2]
公式中I200是2θ=22°–23°之间(200)晶面的最大衍射强度，Iam是2θ=18°–19°之间无定形部分的最小衍射强度。 [2]
CI-XA等于结晶峰面积占整个衍射图谱总面积的百分比，其分析中基线校正后的衍射图用Pearson VII函数进行解卷积。 [2]
Figure 4的图注将CI-XI定义为比较XRD峰强度得到的结晶度指数，将CI-XA定义为比较XRD峰面积得到的结晶度指数。 [4]
Table 1的脚注同样说明CI-XI由衍射强度之比获得，CI-XA由峰面积之比获得。 [1]
文中指出CI-XI值明显高于CI-XA，可能是由于CI-XA分析中无定形贡献被过拟合。 [3]

要点：Jev 100.00% → 最终 100.00%；边界 2/2。

复核结论：核对实际交付给用户的结果；不得拿未通过校验的草稿替代正式答案评分。

软木纤维在0、4000、8000、12000、16000转时的晶粒尺寸依次为4.5、4.6、4.6、4.7、4.7 nm；总体略有增加。 [1]
硬木纤维在0、4000、8000、12000、16000转时的晶粒尺寸依次为4.5、4.7、4.8、4.8、4.7 nm；先增加，在16000转时略降，但仍高于不打浆时。 [1]

Efect of PFI Refining on Crystalline Index and Crystallite Size\n[原文]\nThe trends of CI (CI-XI and CI-XA) for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers were all similar, decreasing first and then increasing, along with a decline, as shown in Figure 4. The fluctuation of the CI was probably because of the mechanical action of PFI refining on the diferent regions of cellulose. In the first refining stage, the decrease of the CI showed that mechanical treatment may mainly act in the crystalline region. Subsequently, the growth of the CI could be interpreted as greater force acting on the amorphous region in which cocrystallization might occur upon drying under the mechanical and thermal action of PFI refining. The subsequent decrease might be the continuous destruction of crystalline region.\n\n[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 3. Results and Discussions > 3.2. Efect of PFI Refining on Crystalline Index and Crystallite Size\n[原文]\nRecently, researches indicated that plant cell walls commonly contained microfibrils with 18 cellulose chains [26]. Frequently adopted arrangements of the 18 cellulose chains are 234432, 34443, and 333333 [27]. Therein, 234432 arrangement was found to be more probable based on calculation [28]. Thus, according to the crystallite sizes (as Table 1 shows) and the unit cell parameters of cellulose Iβ, there was most likely to be an average of two-fibrils with an arrangement of 234,432 packed side-by-side for both softwood fibers and hardwood fibers (as seen in Figure 5, drawn with mercury\n\n[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 3. Results and Discussions > 3.2. Efect of PFI Refining on Crystalline Index and Crystallite Size\n[原文]\n4.1.2 software). The result is consistent with the report of Haigler & Roberts [26], which shows that there might be two microfibrils associated along part of their length.\n\n[原文片段不连续]\n\n[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 3. DeepSeek Flash · High

两种纤维垂直于(200)晶面的晶粒尺寸在PFI打浆过程中总体呈上升趋势。 [2]
针叶木纤维从不打浆到16000转，垂直于(200)晶面的晶粒尺寸依次为4.5、4.6、4.6、4.7、4.7 nm。 [1]
阔叶木纤维从不打浆到16000转，垂直于(200)晶面的晶粒尺寸依次为4.5、4.7、4.8、4.8、4.7 nm。 [1]
阔叶木纤维在16000转时垂直于(200)晶面的晶粒尺寸较12000转时的4.8 nm略降至4.7 nm。 [1]

要点：Jev 100.00% → 最终 100.00%；边界 2/2。

复核结论：核对Table 1的(200)列，两类浆均4.5→4.7 nm；列出的中间波动也正确，不需要额外拒答或边界扣分。

PFI2-011 · 是不是打浆转数越高，纤维素结晶度就越低？

参考答案与评分要点
不是单调下降。针叶木CI-XI从4000转70.42%升到8000转72.54%；阔叶木也从73.01%升到75.06%。0转到16000转总体下降，但过程中先降、回升、再降。

GPT-6 Astra · High

不能简单认为打浆转数越高，纤维素结晶度就越低；PFI打浆过程中结晶度并非单调下降，而是表现为先下降、后回升、再下降的波动趋势。 [2] [4]
以表中数据为例，软木纤维的CI-XI由73.23%降至70.42%，随后升至72.54%，最终降至69.82%；硬木纤维也由75.55%降至73.01%，回升至75.06%，最终降至73.55%。 [4]
不同研究对PFI打浆后结晶度的变化结论并不一致，可能出现下降、先升后降或反复波动，因此应结合纤维原料和具体打浆条件判断。 [1]

要点：Jev 75.00% → 最终 100.00%；边界 2/2。

复核结论：非单调与总体下降分别核对；正确列出的首尾数值可表达总体下降，不强求固定措辞。正确的CI-XA反例同样能否定泛指的结晶度单调下降。

    "text": "[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction\n[原文]\nMechanical, chemical, and biological treatments are usually adopted to obtain the desired physical and mechanical properties and for further utilization of the natural cellulosic fibers. Therein, Papirindustriens forskningsinstitut (PFI) refining is the most common laboratory refiner in order to improve the inter-fiber bonding capacity [1] and accessibility [2,3], and manufacture the micro-fibrillated or nano-fibrillated cellulose [4–6]. The main efects of PFI refining on fibers are: (i) internal fibrillation—delaminating, loosening, and swelling of fiber wall; (ii) external fibrillation—peeling of fibrils from the fiber surface while remaining attached; (iii) fiber shortening—fiber cutting due to shearing action, and (iv) fines formation—primary fines come from ray cells and parenchyma cells and microfibrils that are caused by fiber shortening or external fibrillation. Moreover, the PFI refining could be adopted to obtain a higher internal fibrillation than other laboratory refiners [1]. These efects of the PFI refining on cellulosic fibers will improve the accessibility, the swelling, the flexibility, and the inter-fiber bonding capacity of fibers.\n\n[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction\n[原文]\n It is assumed that these changes in the macro-level structure and properties are related to the changes of crystallinity and H-bonding network during refining [7,8].\n\nThere are some diferent conclusions regarding to the efects of PFI refining on crystallinity of cellulose, not like that of ball milling, which efectively reduces the crystallinity as the treatment progresses. Although some researchers considered that the crystallinity decreased during PFI refining for corn stover [9] or softwood pulp [10], some researchers reported that the crystallinity increased first and then decreased with the degree of refining for hardwood bleached kraft pulp fibers [11] or for unbleached eucalyptus fibers [12]. Moreover, Zhao et al. [7] reported that the crystallinity initially fluctuated upward and then downward, followed by a repeating fluctuation with PFI refining for tobacco stem mechanical pulp. None of the previous studies identified a clear trend, but the results were that the crystallinity varied during PFI refinement. Based on the large proportion of H-bonds in crystalline region of cellulose, it can be assumed that the H-bonding network might change during PFI refining.\n\n[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction\n[原文]\nFourier transformation infrared spectroscopy (FT-IR), which is sensitive to molecular structure, can be as an indirect measurement for studying H-bonding network. FT-IR deconvolution of hydroxyl groups band was adopted in order to study the changes of the energy of H-bonds and the H-bonding distance during delignification [13] or the deconstruction of cellulose [14]. Moreover, it was used to study the diferences of the content of H-bonds not only between dislocation region and normal region [15], but also among plant species [16,17]. Regarding the changes of H-bonding network during PFI refining, Yuan et al. [18] reported that the content of H-bonds and crystallinity index (CI) of eucalyptus fibers changed with the increment of beating time. Subsequently, Zhao et al. [8] found that the H-bonding energy for O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) inter-molecular H-bonds decreased by 12.9% and evolutions of the content of certain H-bonds difered at various refining stages.\n\n[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction\n[原文]\nThere is still a lack of literature on the efects of PFI refinement on the H-bonding network. Particularly, the relationship between the content of H-bonds and crystallinity is still worthy of further study, which will deepen the understanding of the molecular aggregation and distribution of H-bonds, providing a molecular-scale explanation for the variations in accessibility, swelling, flexibility, and fibrillation of cellulosic fibers during PFI refinement. Therefore, this work explored the efects of PFI refinement on the CI, crystallite size, energy of H-bonds, H-bonding distance, and content of H-bonds for softwood pulp fibers and hardwood pulp fibers. Attempts were made in order to establish the correlations between the CI and content of various H-bonds.",

DeepSeek Flash · High

关于PFI精磨对纤维素结晶度的影响，已有研究结论并不一致，并未确认结晶度会随打浆程度提高而单调降低。 [1]
本研究中软木浆和硬木浆的CI-XI与CI-XA随PFI打浆转数总体呈先下降、后上升、再下降的波动趋势。 [2]
软木浆的CI-XA在0、4,000、8,000、12,000和16,000转时分别为40.46%、37.71%、39.65%、36.22%和34.20%，显示4,000转下降后8,000转回升。 [4]
硬木浆的CI-XA在0、4,000、8,000、12,000和16,000转时分别为47.16%、36.26%、42.35%、39.21%和38.01%，同样不是单调下降。 [4]
因此，打浆转数提高在本研究中使16,000转的结晶度指数低于未打浆，但中间存在回升，不能概括为转数越高结晶度越低。 [2] [4]

要点：Jev 100.00% → 最终 100.00%；边界 2/2。

复核结论：非单调与总体下降分别核对；正确列出的首尾数值可表达总体下降，不强求固定措辞。正确的CI-XA反例同样能否定泛指的结晶度单调下降。

    "text": "[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction\n[原文]\nMechanical, chemical, and biological treatments are usually adopted to obtain the desired physical and mechanical properties and for further utilization of the natural cellulosic fibers. Therein, Papirindustriens forskningsinstitut (PFI) refining is the most common laboratory refiner in order to improve the inter-fiber bonding capacity [1] and accessibility [2,3], and manufacture the micro-fibrillated or nano-fibrillated cellulose [4–6]. The main efects of PFI refining on fibers are: (i) internal fibrillation—delaminating, loosening, and swelling of fiber wall; (ii) external fibrillation—peeling of fibrils from the fiber surface while remaining attached; (iii) fiber shortening—fiber cutting due to shearing action, and (iv) fines formation—primary fines come from ray cells and parenchyma cells and microfibrils that are caused by fiber shortening or external fibrillation. Moreover, the PFI refining could be adopted to obtain a higher internal fibrillation than other laboratory refiners [1]. These efects of the PFI refining on cellulosic fibers will improve the accessibility, the swelling, the flexibility, and the inter-fiber bonding capacity of fibers.\n\n[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction\n[原文]\n It is assumed that these changes in the macro-level structure and properties are related to the changes of crystallinity and H-bonding network during refining [7,8].\n\nThere are some diferent conclusions regarding to the efects of PFI refining on crystallinity of cellulose, not like that of ball milling, which efectively reduces the crystallinity as the treatment progresses. Although some researchers considered that the crystallinity decreased during PFI refining for corn stover [9] or softwood pulp [10], some researchers reported that the crystallinity increased first and then decreased with the degree of refining for hardwood bleached kraft pulp fibers [11] or for unbleached eucalyptus fibers [12]. Moreover, Zhao et al. [7] reported that the crystallinity initially fluctuated upward and then downward, followed by a repeating fluctuation with PFI refining for tobacco stem mechanical pulp. None of the previous studies identified a clear trend, but the results were that the crystallinity varied during PFI refinement. Based on the large proportion of H-bonds in crystalline region of cellulose, it can be assumed that the H-bonding network might change during PFI refining.\n\n[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction\n[原文]\nFourier transformation infrared spectroscopy (FT-IR), which is sensitive to molecular structure, can be as an indirect measurement for studying H-bonding network. FT-IR deconvolution of hydroxyl groups band was adopted in order to study the changes of the energy of H-bonds and the H-bonding distance during delignification [13] or the deconstruction of cellulose [14]. Moreover, it was used to study the diferences of the content of H-bonds not only between dislocation region and normal region [15], but also among plant species [16,17]. Regarding the changes of H-bonding network during PFI refining, Yuan et al. [18] reported that the content of H-bonds and crystallinity index (CI) of eucalyptus fibers changed with the increment of beating time. Subsequently, Zhao et al. [8] found that the H-bonding energy for O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) inter-molecular H-bonds decreased by 12.9% and evolutions of the content of certain H-bonds difered at various refining stages.\n\n[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction\n[原文]\nThere is still a lack of literature on the efects of PFI refinement on the H-bonding network. Particularly, the relationship between the content of H-bonds and crystallinity is still worthy of further study, which will deepen the understanding of the molecular aggregation and distribution of H-bonds, providing a molecular-scale explanation for the variations in accessibility, swelling, flexibility, and fibrillation of cellulosic fibers during PFI refinement. Therefore, this work explored the efects of PFI refinement on the CI, crystallite size, energy of H-bonds, H-bonding distance, and content of H-bonds for softwood pulp fibers and hardwood pulp fibers. Attempts were made in order to establish the correlations between the CI and content of various H-bonds.",

DeepSeek Flash · High

表1中各精磨转数下CI-XI均高于CI-XA，原文也指出CI-XI显著高于CI-XA。 [1] [2]
CI-XI高于CI-XA可能与CI-XA分析中非晶贡献过拟合有关。 [1]
CI-XI与CI-XA在软木纤维和硬木纤维中均显著相关。 [1]
软木纤维的CI-XI与CI-XA相关系数为0.919（p < 0.05）。 [1]
硬木纤维的CI-XI与CI-XA相关系数为0.925（p < 0.05）。 [1]

要点：Jev 100.00% → 最终 100.00%；边界 2/2。

复核结论：CI-XI高于CI-XA；两者r=0.919/0.925且p<0.05，未与氢键相关系数混用。

PFI2-013 · PFI打浆过程中结晶度为什么会先降、再升、再降？

参考答案与评分要点
作者提出：早期可能主要作用于晶区使CI下降；随后对无定形区的作用以及干燥时可能的共结晶使CI回升；后期晶区继续破坏使CI再降。原文使用可能、可以解释等措辞，属于作者的机制解释，不是排除其他机制后的唯一因果证明。

GPT-6 Astra · High

论文将这种先降、再升、再降的变化解释为打浆作用区域随阶段改变：初期主要影响纤维素晶区，因此结晶指数下降；之后较强作用更多影响非晶区，干燥过程中可能发生共结晶，使指数回升；后期晶区继续受到破坏，指数再次下降。作者将此作为可能的解释。 [1] [2]
一种与该变化相呼应的证据是，晶区含量较高的 O(6)H···O(3′) 分子间氢键含量也呈先降、再升、再降的趋势，并且与 CI-XI 显著正相关；但这支持的是两者共同变化，并不能单独证明上述机制。 [3]
因此，这里的“结晶度”应理解为研究测得的结晶指数变化；研究还报告纤维素晶型在 PFI 处理过程中没有改变。 [1] [2]

要点：Jev 100.00% → 最终 100.00%；边界 2/2。

复核结论：核对晶区—非晶区/干燥共结晶—后续破坏的解释及可能性措辞；实际引用中的表格也可直接支持数值走势。

      "text": "论文将这种先降、再升、再降的变化解释为打浆作用区域随阶段改变：初期主要影响纤维素晶区，因此结晶指数下降；之后较强作用更多影响非晶区，干燥过程中可能发生共结晶，使指数回升；后期晶区继续受到破坏，指数再次下降。作者将此作为可能的解释。",

    "text": "[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction\n[原文]\nMechanical, chemical, and biological treatments are usually adopted to obtain the desired physical and mechanical properties and for further utilization of the natural cellulosic fibers. Therein, Papirindustriens forskningsinstitut (PFI) refining is the most common laboratory refiner in order to improve the inter-fiber bonding capacity [1] and accessibility [2,3], and manufacture the micro-fibrillated or nano-fibrillated cellulose [4–6]. The main efects of PFI refining on fibers are: (i) internal fibrillation—delaminating, loosening, and swelling of fiber wall; (ii) external fibrillation—peeling of fibrils from the fiber surface while remaining attached; (iii) fiber shortening—fiber cutting due to shearing action, and (iv) fines formation—primary fines come from ray cells and parenchyma cells and microfibrils that are caused by fiber shortening or external fibrillation. Moreover, the PFI refining could be adopted to obtain a higher internal fibrillation than other laboratory refiners [1]. These efects of the PFI refining on cellulosic fibers will improve the accessibility, the swelling, the flexibility, and the inter-fiber bonding capacity of fibers.\n\n[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction\n[原文]\n It is assumed that these changes in the macro-level structure and properties are related to the changes of crystallinity and H-bonding network during refining [7,8].\n\nThere are some diferent conclusions regarding to the efects of PFI refining on crystallinity of cellulose, not like that of ball milling, which efectively reduces the crystallinity as the treatment progresses. Although some researchers considered that the crystallinity decreased during PFI refining for corn stover [9] or softwood pulp [10], some researchers reported that the crystallinity increased first and then decreased with the degree of refining for hardwood bleached kraft pulp fibers [11] or for unbleached eucalyptus fibers [12]. Moreover, Zhao et al. [7] reported that the crystallinity initially fluctuated upward and then downward, followed by a repeating fluctuation with PFI refining for tobacco stem mechanical pulp. None of the previous studies identified a clear trend, but the results were that the crystallinity varied during PFI refinement. Based on the large proportion of H-bonds in crystalline region of cellulose, it can be assumed that the H-bonding network might change during PFI refining.\n\n[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction\n[原文]\nFourier transformation infrared spectroscopy (FT-IR), which is sensitive to molecular structure, can be as an indirect measurement for studying H-bonding network. FT-IR deconvolution of hydroxyl groups band was adopted in order to study the changes of the energy of H-bonds and the H-bonding distance during delignification [13] or the deconstruction of cellulose [14]. Moreover, it was used to study the diferences of the content of H-bonds not only between dislocation region and normal region [15], but also among plant species [16,17]. Regarding the changes of H-bonding network during PFI refining, Yuan et al. [18] reported that the content of H-bonds and crystallinity index (CI) of eucalyptus fibers changed with the increment of beating time. Subsequently, Zhao et al. [8] found that the H-bonding energy for O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) inter-molecular H-bonds decreased by 12.9% and evolutions of the content of certain H-bonds difered at various refining stages.\n\n[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction\n[原文]\nThere is still a lack of literature on the efects of PFI refinement on the H-bonding network. Particularly, the relationship between the content of H-bonds and crystallinity is still worthy of further study, which will deepen the understanding of the molecular aggregation and distribution of H-bonds, providing a molecular-scale explanation for the variations in accessibility, swelling, flexibility, and fibrillation of cellulosic fibers during PFI refinement. Therefore, this work explored the efects of PFI refinement on the CI, crystallite size, energy of H-bonds, H-bonding distance, and content of H-bonds for softwood pulp fibers and hardwood pulp fibers. Attempts were made in order to establish the correlations between the CI and content of various H-bonds.",

DeepSeek Flash · High

两种浆的CI-XI和CI-XA随PFI打浆均呈先下降、再上升、随后下降的相似波动趋势。 [2] [4]
第一阶段的结晶度下降表明，PFI机械处理可能主要作用于纤维素的结晶区。 [2]
随后的结晶度上升可解释为更强的机械力作用于无定形区，并在PFI的机械和热作用下干燥时可能发生共结晶。 [2]
最后的结晶度下降可能是结晶区被持续破坏所致。 [2]
CI-XI与O(6)H···O(3′)分子间氢键含量的变化趋势相似且显著相关（软木纤维0.912、硬木纤维0.889，p<0.05），而结晶区该氢键含量高于无定形区。 [3]

要点：Jev 100.00% → 最终 100.00%；边界 2/2。

复核结论：核对晶区—非晶区/干燥共结晶—后续破坏的解释及可能性措辞；实际引用中的表格也可直接支持数值走势。

The CI-XI (crystallinity index obtained by comparing intensity of X-ray difractometer (XRD) peaks) and CI-XA (crystallinity index obtained by comparing area of XRD peaks) for refined and unrefined samples: (a) softwood fiber and (b) hardwood fiber.\n\n[原文片段不连续]\n\n[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 3. Results and Discussions > 3.2. Efect of PFI Refining on Crystalline Index and Crystallite Size\n[原文]\nThe trends of CI (CI-XI and CI-XA) for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers were all similar, decreasing first and then increasing, along with a decline, as shown in Figure 4. The fluctuation of the CI was probably because of the mechanical action of PFI refining on the diferent regions of cellulose. In the first refining stage, the decrease of the CI showed that mechanical treatment may mainly act in the crystalline region. Subsequently, the growth of the CI could be interpreted as greater force acting on the amorphous region in which cocrystallization might occur upon drying under the mechanical and thermal action of PFI refining. PFI2-014 · 按照作者的解释，PFI打浆为什么会提高WRV，又如何与纤维间结合联系起来？

参考答案与评分要点
打浆促进细纤维化，产生新的表面和更多孔隙，使WRV及纤维膨胀提高；纤维横向更柔顺，有助于改善纤维网络中的纤维间结合。这是本文提出的解释链条，不能据此给出每一步的独立因果效应大小。

作者认为，PFI打浆增强纤维原纤化，形成新的表面和更多孔隙，促进吸水膨胀，因此WRV上升。 [2]
WRV所表征的膨胀使纤维横向更柔顺，作者认为这有助于提高纤维网络中的纤维间结合强度。 [2]
作者还将较高WRV联系到纤维素链间氢键减少和结晶指数降低：这些变化提高分子链活动性及水的可及性，从而促进纤维柔顺、膨胀和WRV。 [1]

DeepSeek Flash · High

PFI打浆的主要作用包括内部细纤维化（纤维壁分层、疏松和润胀）、外部细纤维化、纤维切断和细小组分形成，并提高纤维的可及性、润胀、柔性和纤维间结合能力。 [3]
作者将打浆度和WRV随PFI转数增加而显著增加归因于更高程度的细纤维化产生了新的表面和更多孔隙。 [2]
WRV表征的润胀增加使纤维在横向更柔顺，从而有助于提高纤维网络的纤维间结合强度。 [2]
在分子层面，PFI的机械作用可能使纤维素分子链断裂，减少O(6)H···O(3′)分子间氢键，并与内部和外部细纤维化密切相关。 [1]
较少的分子间氢键和较低的结晶指数会通过提高分子链运动性、可及性和WRV来进一步提高纤维素纤维的柔性。 [1] [4]

要点：Jev 100.00% → 最终 100.00%；边界 2/2。

复核结论：主干WRV—膨胀—横向柔顺—结合链条正确；区分作者的分子层面解释、链间氢键与纤维素主链断裂。

    "text": "[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction\n[原文]\nMechanical, chemical, and biological treatments are usually adopted to obtain the desired physical and mechanical properties and for further utilization of the natural cellulosic fibers. Therein, Papirindustriens forskningsinstitut (PFI) refining is the most common laboratory refiner in order to improve the inter-fiber bonding capacity [1] and accessibility [2,3], and manufacture the micro-fibrillated or nano-fibrillated cellulose [4–6]. The main efects of PFI refining on fibers are: (i) internal fibrillation—delaminating, loosening, and swelling of fiber wall; (ii) external fibrillation—peeling of fibrils from the fiber surface while remaining attached; (iii) fiber shortening—fiber cutting due to shearing action, and (iv) fines formation—primary fines come from ray cells and parenchyma cells and microfibrils that are caused by fiber shortening or external fibrillation. Moreover, the PFI refining could be adopted to obtain a higher internal fibrillation than other laboratory refiners [1]. These efects of the PFI refining on cellulosic fibers will improve the accessibility, the swelling, the flexibility, and the inter-fiber bonding capacity of fibers.\n\n[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction\n[原文]\n It is assumed that these changes in the macro-level structure and properties are related to the changes of crystallinity and H-bonding network during refining [7,8].\n\nThere are some diferent conclusions regarding to the efects of PFI refining on crystallinity of cellulose, not like that of ball milling, which efectively reduces the crystallinity as the treatment progresses. Although some researchers considered that the crystallinity decreased during PFI refining for corn stover [9] or softwood pulp [10], some researchers reported that the crystallinity increased first and then decreased with the degree of refining for hardwood bleached kraft pulp fibers [11] or for unbleached eucalyptus fibers [12]. Moreover, Zhao et al. [7] reported that the crystallinity initially fluctuated upward and then downward, followed by a repeating fluctuation with PFI refining for tobacco stem mechanical pulp. None of the previous studies identified a clear trend, but the results were that the crystallinity varied during PFI refinement. Based on the large proportion of H-bonds in crystalline region of cellulose, it can be assumed that the H-bonding network might change during PFI refining.\n\n[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction\n[原文]\nFourier transformation infrared spectroscopy (FT-IR), which is sensitive to molecular structure, can be as an indirect measurement for studying H-bonding network. FT-IR deconvolution of hydroxyl groups band was adopted in order to study the changes of the energy of H-bonds and the H-bonding distance during delignification [13] or the deconstruction of cellulose [14]. Moreover, it was used to study the diferences of the content of H-bonds not only between dislocation region and normal region [15], but also among plant species [16,17]. Regarding the changes of H-bonding network during PFI refining, Yuan et al. [18] reported that the content of H-bonds and crystallinity index (CI) of eucalyptus fibers changed with the increment of beating time. Subsequently, Zhao et al. [8] found that the H-bonding energy for O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) inter-molecular H-bonds decreased by 12.9% and evolutions of the content of certain H-bonds difered at various refining stages.\n\n[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction\n[原文]\nThere is still a lack of literature on the efects of PFI refinement on the H-bonding network. Particularly, the relationship between the content of H-bonds and crystallinity is still worthy of further study, which will deepen the understanding of the molecular aggregation and distribution of H-bonds, providing a molecular-scale explanation for the variations in accessibility, swelling, flexibility, and fibrillation of cellulosic fibers during PFI refinement. Therefore, this work explored the efects of PFI refinement on the CI, crystallite size, energy of H-bonds, H-bonding distance, and content of H-bonds for softwood pulp fibers and hardwood pulp fibers. Attempts were made in order to establish the correlations between the CI and content of various H-bonds.",

PFI2-015 · 针叶木和阔叶木打浆后纤维长度的变化一样吗？为什么会有差别？

参考答案与评分要点
正文文字报告针叶木纤维长度变化明显，阔叶木相对变化不显著；作者认为可能与阔叶木采用较低的打浆作用力有关。两类浆的作用力不同，因此不能把差异全部归因于浆种。

GPT-6 Astra · High

在该PFI打浆试验中，软木纤维的平均长度随打浆转数增加而明显下降；从图中约可见其由2050 μm降至1650 μm左右。 [1]
阔叶木纤维的平均长度仅有小幅下降，研究指出其纤维长度变化相对于软木并不显著。 [1]
差别主要与打浆压力不同有关：软木纤维的单位杆长作用力为3.33 N/mm，而阔叶木仅为1.77 N/mm；原文将阔叶木变化较小归因于较低的打浆压力。 [1] [5]

要点：Jev 未能有效评分 → 最终 83.33%；边界 1/2。

复核结论：另行完整补评。核对正文及实际附加Figure 1近似长度；两侧均把原文might改得偏确定，因此解释要点P2只给0.5。两侧都明确提供不同作用力并以该处理差异解释组间差异，P3接受其语义等价表达。

The drainability was characterized by the Schopper Riegler number (SR-number) with the standards ISO 5267-1. DeepSeek Flash · High

PFI打浆后针叶木纤维长度显著下降，而阔叶木纤维长度无显著变化。 [1]
从 Figure 1 近似读取，针叶木的平均长度加权纤维长度由约2000 μm降至约1600 μm，阔叶木约900 μm且基本持平。 [1]
文献将阔叶木纤维相关参数无显著变化归因于其打浆时施加的较低 refining pressure。 [1]
方法中每单位棒长作用力为3.33 N/mm（针叶木）和1.77 N/mm（阔叶木）。 [5]

要点：Jev 未能有效评分 → 最终 83.33%；边界 1/2。

复核结论：另行完整补评。核对正文及实际附加Figure 1近似长度；两侧均把原文might改得偏确定，因此解释要点P2只给0.5。两侧都明确提供不同作用力并以该处理差异解释组间差异，P3接受其语义等价表达。

PFI2-016 · 为什么本文认为纸张抗张性能提高，并不意味着单根纤维本身的强度也一定提高？零距抗张在这里有什么用？

参考答案与评分要点
作者将纸张抗张性能改善主要联系到细纤维化、细小纤维及纤维间结合。零距抗张指数用于表征纤维本身的抗张强度，结果表明本文PFI处理没有降低纤维强度。因此应区分纸页网络性能和纤维本身强度，不能只凭纸张变强推断单根纤维必然变强。

GPT-6 Astra · High

纸张抗张性能是纤维网络层面的结果。PFI精炼提高了纤维的内、外部原纤化、细小组分含量、溶胀和柔顺性，从而增强纤维间结合，因此纸页强度可以提高。 [1]
上述网络结构和结合状态的改善，并不要求单根纤维的本征强度同步提高；所以纸页抗张强度上升不能直接推出单根纤维也变强。 [1]
零距抗张指数通常用于表征纤维本身的抗张强度，本文按 ISO 15361 测定它，并将其作为区别“纤维本身强度”和“纤维间结合贡献”的参照。 [1] [2]
本文的零距抗张结果表明，PFI精炼没有降低纤维强度；结合纸页抗张强度的提高，说明强度增益主要来自原纤化、细小组分和纤维间结合的改善，而不是单根纤维强度必然增加。 [1]

要点：Jev 100.00% → 最终 100.00%；边界 2/2。

复核结论：区分纸页网络与单根纤维，零距指标用于纤维本体强度；“未降低”不能升级为“已排除纤维强度提高的贡献”。

      "text": "本文的零距抗张结果表明，PFI精炼没有降低纤维强度；结合纸页抗张强度的提高，说明强度增益主要来自原纤化、细小组分和纤维间结合的改善，而不是单根纤维强度必然增加。",
      "claim_type": "fact",
      "support": "supported",
      "basis_locator": "E14",
      "basis": {
        "type": "reference_evidence",
        "text": "In Figure 3, the tensile index, zero-span tensile index, and wet-web strength represented as a function of the refining revolutions. The increment of tensile strength is mainly caused by the increasing fibrillation and fines during PFI refining, as mentioned above. The wet–web strength of softwood fiber had a more significant increase when compared to that of hardwood fiber. It is for that fiber length plays an essential role in wet–web strength. The zero-span tensile index was usually used in characterizing the tensile strength of fibers. The results of the zero-span tensile index showed that PFI refining did not reduce fiber strength, which is consistent with the report of Kouko et al. [24]. The above results showed that PFI refining improved the extent of fibrillation (especially the internal fibrillation), the swelling of fibers, and the tensile strength of sheets without a decrease of the tensile strength of fibers."
      }

  "raw_review_sha256": "af726d967176a2753bfa11dc95b6dea2ab19840e608b1ed02a34d7f4eff2f16a",
  "summary": "区分纸页网络与单根纤维，零距指标用于纤维本体强度；“未降低”不能升级为“已排除纤维强度提高的贡献”。",

    "E14",
    "actual_claims_and_attached_citations"
  ],
  "changes": []
}

DeepSeek Flash · High

本文指出，PFI精磨过程中片材抗张强度的提高主要来自细纤维化和细组分的增加，而不是直接来自单根纤维强度的提高。 [1]
细纤维化产生新的表面和更多孔隙，并提高纤维润胀（WRV），使纤维横向更柔顺，从而改善纤维间结合强度。 [1]
零距抗张指数通常用于表征纤维的拉伸强度，因此可用于检查精磨对纤维本体强度的影响。 [1]
本文零距抗张结果表明PFI精磨没有降低纤维强度，这与Kouko等的报道一致。 [1]
因此，本文结论是PFI精磨提高了细纤维化程度、纤维润胀和片材抗张强度，但没有出现纤维拉伸强度的下降。 [1]
零距抗张强度按ISO 15361用Z-Span 2400仪器测定。 [2]

要点：Jev 100.00% → 最终 83.33%；边界 1/2。

复核结论：区分纸页网络与单根纤维，零距指标用于纤维本体强度；“未降低”不能升级为“已排除纤维强度提高的贡献”。

DeepSeek Flash · High

针叶木浆（softwood fibers）的湿纸幅强度增幅比阔叶木浆（hardwood fibers）更明显。 [1]
作者将其解释为纤维长度在湿纸幅强度中起关键作用。 [1]

要点：Jev 100.00% → 最终 100.00%；边界 2/2。

复核结论：针叶木湿纸幅增幅更明显，作者强调纤维长度作用，结论与方向均正确。

Jev原始五维评分与最终评分

      "id": "C1",
      "text": "针叶木浆（softwood fibers）的湿纸幅强度增幅比阔叶木浆（hardwood fibers）更明显。",
      "claim_type": "fact",
      "support": "supported",
      "basis_locator": "E14",
      "basis": {
        "type": "reference_evidence",
        "text": "In Figure 3, the tensile index, zero-span tensile index, and wet-web strength represented as a function of the refining revolutions. The increment of tensile strength is mainly caused by the increasing fibrillation and fines during PFI refining, as mentioned above. The wet–web strength of softwood fiber had a more significant increase when compared to that of hardwood fiber. It is for that fiber length plays an essential role in wet–web strength. The zero-span tensile index was usually used in characterizing the tensile strength of fibers. The results of the zero-span tensile index showed that PFI refining did not reduce fiber strength, which is consistent with the report of Kouko et al. [24]. The above results showed that PFI refining improved the extent of fibrillation (especially the internal fibrillation), the swelling of fibers, and the tensile strength of sheets without a decrease of the tensile strength of fibers."

PFI2-018 · 这篇论文如何从FT-IR获得不同氢键的相对含量？请说明拟合波段、函数和含量口径。

参考答案与评分要点
先归一化并用二阶导数辅助确定峰位；对3000–3700 cm⁻¹羟基区域采用高斯函数非线性拟合，软件为Peakfit 4.12；各组分相对含量按峰面积占比计算，不能当作绝对氢键数量。

将FT-IR谱在1016 cm⁻¹处归一化，并用Savitzky–Golay算法求导；依据二阶导数谱识别氢键组分的位置，再对3000–3700 cm⁻¹羟基伸缩区作非线性高斯拟合，使用Peakfit 4.12。 [1]
拟合分为四个组分：游离OH(2)/OH(6)，3580–3550 cm⁻¹；分子内O(2)H···O(6)，3455–3410 cm⁻¹；分子内O(3)H···O(5)，3375–3340 cm⁻¹；分子间O(6)H···O(3′)，3310–3230 cm⁻¹。 [3]
相对含量以各拟合组分的峰面积占比表示，即该组分面积占各组分总面积的比例，并以百分数报告；表中同时列出三类氢键和游离OH的相对含量。 [3]

要点：Jev 66.67% → 最终 66.67%；边界 1/2。

复核结论：波段、Gaussian、面积比例均正确；两侧均未明确相对比例不等于绝对氢键数量，独立P3仍为0。图中四分峰和表内四项比例另按实际原图核查。

Efect of PFI Refining on H-Bonding Energies, H-Bonding Distances, and Content of H-Bonds\n[原文]\n On the whole, the amount of the O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) H-bonds for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers decreased by 16.54% and 5.91% altogether, respectively. The decrease might be due to the cleavage among cellulose molecular chains under the mechanical action of PFI refining, which was closely related to internal and external fibrillation (as seen in Section 3.1). On the other hand, the increase illustrates that there was not only the breakage, but also the formation of O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) H-bonds. Both the fewer inter-molecular H-bonds and the lower CI (as Section 3.2 shows) will further improve the flexibility of cellulosic fibers, due to the higher mobility of molecular chains, the accessibility, and the WRV of fibers (as seen in Section 3.1).",

DeepSeek Flash · High

FT-IR谱以KBr压片、透射模式采集4000–400 cm⁻¹，分辨率4 cm⁻¹，64次扫描平均，并以五次记录的平均谱分析；光谱在1016 cm⁻¹归一化。 [1]
用Savitzky–Golay算法获得导数曲线，并按不同氢键所属波数区间从二阶导数谱确定各氢键组分的峰位。 [1]
对3000–3700 cm⁻¹的羟基伸缩振动区进行非线性拟合，采用Gaussian函数，软件为Peakfit 4.12。 [1]
峰位归属为：3580–3550 cm⁻¹为free OH(2)和OH(6)；3455–3410 cm⁻¹为O(2)H···O(6)分子内氢键；3375–3340 cm⁻¹为O(3)H···O(5)分子内氢键；3310–3230 cm⁻¹为O(6)H···O(3′)分子间氢键（cellulose I）。 [3]
结果中将3000–3700 cm⁻¹羟基带反卷积为四个主要分峰，各氢键的相对含量按对应分峰面积占四个分峰总面积的比例计算。 [3]
Figure 7显示每个样品拟合出四个Gaussian分峰：三类氢键与free OH(2)/OH(6)；Table 2以百分比列出这些组分的相对含量，四项合计约为100%，并给出r²约0.999。 [3]

要点：Jev 66.67% → 最终 66.67%；边界 1/2。

复核结论：波段、Gaussian、面积比例均正确；两侧均未明确相对比例不等于绝对氢键数量，独立P3仍为0。图中四分峰和表内四项比例另按实际原图核查。

Results and Discussions > 3.3. Efect of PFI Refining on H-Bonding Energies, H-Bonding Distances, and Content of H-Bonds\n[原文]\nIn the case of the O(2)H· · · O(6) intra-molecular H-bonds for softwood fiber, the trend of content can be described as two phases. It had an increase of 3.5% from 31.4% to 32.5% in the stage of refining from 0 r to 4000 r and it then decreased by 21.57% from 4000 r to 12000 r, along with a growth of 15.26% in the last refining stage. For the content of the O(2)H· · · O(6) H-bonds of hardwood fiber, it increased firstly and then had a decrease that was also followed by an increase. For both fibers, the content of O(2)H· · · O(6) H-bonds decreased, except for the stage of refining from 0 r to 4000 r. It might be due to the fact that the O(2)H· · · O(6) H-bonds, which are much more accessible to water, are less stable than O(3)H· · · O(5) H-bonds.\n\n[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 3. Results and Discussions > 3.3. Efect of PFI Refining on H-Bonding Energies, H-Bonding Distances, and Content of H-Bonds\n[原文]\nAs to the free OH(2) and OH(6) of softwood fiber, the relative content showed a slight increase trend in general. The enhancement of the free OH(2) and OH(6) was understandable, because there was the breakage of H-bonds among cellulosic molecules, which resulted in more extensive delamination and higher specific surface area (as shown in Figure S4 and Table S1 in Online Resource). This made cellulose more accessible to water and chemicals. However, for the free OH(2) and OH(6) of hardwood fiber, the number of the free OH(2) and OH(6) decreased by 21.65% from 14.32% to 11.22%, with revolutions increasing from 0 r to 4000 r, followed by an increase of 45.37% in the stage of refining from 4000 r to 12,000 r, along with an decrease of 17.11%. It could be explained by the instability of free OH groups, which makes it easy to form new H-bonds, such as O(2)H· · · O(6) or O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>)H-bonds. Thus although there is the formation of free OH(2) and OH(6) during fibrillation, the content of the free OH(2) and OH(6) might disease; meanwhile, the content of the O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) or the O(2)H· · · O(6) H-bonds might increase upon drying.",

It had an increase of 3.5% from 31.4% to 32.5% in the stage of refining from 0 r to 4000 r and it then decreased by 21.57% from 4000 r to 12000 r, along with a growth of 15.26% in the last refining stage. For the content of the O(2)H· · · O(6) H-bonds of hardwood fiber, it increased firstly and then had a decrease that was also followed by an increase. Efect of PFI Refining on H-Bonding Energies, H-Bonding Distances, and Content of H-Bonds\n[原文]\nAs to the free OH(2) and OH(6) of softwood fiber, the relative content showed a slight increase trend in general. This made cellulose more accessible to water and chemicals. However, for the free OH(2) and OH(6) of hardwood fiber, the number of the free OH(2) and OH(6) decreased by 21.65% from 14.32% to 11.22%, with revolutions increasing from 0 r to 4000 r, followed by an increase of 45.37% in the stage of refining from 4000 r to 12,000 r, along with an decrease of 17.11%. It could be explained by the instability of free OH groups, which makes it easy to form new H-bonds, such as O(2)H· · · O(6) or O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>)H-bonds. Thus although there is the formation of free OH(2) and OH(6) during fibrillation, the content of the free OH(2) and OH(6) might disease; meanwhile, the content of the O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) or the O(2)H· · · O(6) H-bonds might increase upon drying.",

PFI2-020 · 论文说打浆后氢键能量和距离基本不变，那是不是说明打浆对氢键网络基本没影响？

参考答案与评分要点
不表示完全不变。本文三类氢键的峰位几乎不变，因此据公式推得能量和距离基本不变；但相对含量仍变化：0到16000转，针叶木分子间氢键由28.23%变为23.56%，阔叶木由26.55%变为24.98%。应区分单类氢键能量/距离与不同组分的相对分布。

GPT-6 Astra · High

更准确地说，PFI 打浆后，三类已识别氢键的峰位基本不变，因此由峰位推算的氢键能量和距离基本不变；这说明它们的局部氢键几何和强度变化有限。 [1] [2]
但氢键的相对含量明显发生变化：例如软木纤维中，分子间 O(6)H···O(3′) 氢键由 28.23% 变为 23.56%，而分子内 O(3)H···O(5) 氢键由 28.44% 变为 34.92%。 [1] [3]
不同氢键的变化并不完全一致；O(2)H···O(6) 氢键和自由 OH 的含量随打浆转数呈阶段性波动，说明氢键的断裂、重组和可及性变化同时存在。 [1] [3]
因此，打浆影响的是氢键网络的数量分布、连接关系及其与晶区组织的耦合，而不是普遍改变每一种氢键的单个能量和距离；分子间 O(6)H···O(3′) 氢键含量还与结晶指数呈显著相关。 [2] [4] [5]

要点：Jev 100.00% → 最终 100.00%；边界 2/2。

复核结论：能量/距离基本稳定与组分相对比例变化应区分；原文的机制推测不自动证明全部网络连接或同时发生的微观过程。

The decrease might be due to the cleavage among cellulose molecular chains under the mechanical action of PFI refining, which was closely related to internal and external fibrillation (as seen in Section 3.1). On the other hand, the increase illustrates that there was not only the breakage, but also the formation of O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) H-bonds. Results and Discussions > 3.3. Efect of PFI Refining on H-Bonding Energies, H-Bonding Distances, and Content of H-Bonds\n[原文]\nAs to the O(3)H· · · O(5) intra-molecular H-bonds of softwood fiber, the content had a growth of 10.09% from 28.44% to 31.31% in the stage of refining from 0 r to 4000 r, and then had a slight decrease of 1.44% from 4000 r to 8000 r, followed by an increase of 13.16% until the end of refining. Overall, the trend was similar to that of hardwood fibers, which first increased and then had a decrease, followed by a growth. During the whole refining, the amount of $\\mathrm { O } ( 3 ) \\mathrm { H } \\cdots \\mathrm { O } ( 5 )$ H-bonds for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers showed an upward tendency and increased by 22.78% and 8.8%, respectively. The increase might be because the stable O(3)H· · · O(5) H-bonds might have not only less breakage under the action of water as destructor to the crystallites [30], but also creation in the amorphous region upon drying. Because hydrogen bond–covalent bond synergies play an important role in the cellulose stifness axial modulus, more O(3)H· · · O(5) H-bonds will enhance the cellulose stifness [33,34].\n\n[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 3. For the content of the O(2)H· · · O(6) H-bonds of hardwood fiber, it increased firstly and then had a decrease that was also followed by an increase.     "text": "[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 未确定\n[原文]\nAbstract: Supramolecular structure is the critical factor that afects the properties of cellulosic fibers. This article studied the action of Papirindustriens forskningsinstitut (PFI) refining on the molecular aggregation and hydrogen bonding network, and tried to explore the relationship between the crystal packing and hydrogen-bonding network in cellulosic fibers. The results showed that the polymorph, H-bonding distance, and H-bonding energy of various H-bonds remained almost unchanged, while the crystalline index, crystallite size, and content of various H-bonds changed with refining. Therein, the content of the inter-molecular O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) H-bonds was significantly correlated with the crystalline index that was obtained in intensities of the XRD peaks. The Pearson correlation coeficient between them was 0.888 (p < 0.05) for softwood fibers and 0.889 (p < 0.05) for hardwood fibers, respectively. It can be concluded that the variations of accessibility, swelling, and fibrillation were closely related to the supramolecular structure and the intermolecular H-bonds play an important role in the crystal packing of cellulose.",

    "text": "[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction\n[原文]\nMechanical, chemical, and biological treatments are usually adopted to obtain the desired physical and mechanical properties and for further utilization of the natural cellulosic fibers. Therein, Papirindustriens forskningsinstitut (PFI) refining is the most common laboratory refiner in order to improve the inter-fiber bonding capacity [1] and accessibility [2,3], and manufacture the micro-fibrillated or nano-fibrillated cellulose [4–6]. The main efects of PFI refining on fibers are: (i) internal fibrillation—delaminating, loosening, and swelling of fiber wall; (ii) external fibrillation—peeling of fibrils from the fiber surface while remaining attached; (iii) fiber shortening—fiber cutting due to shearing action, and (iv) fines formation—primary fines come from ray cells and parenchyma cells and microfibrils that are caused by fiber shortening or external fibrillation. Moreover, the PFI refining could be adopted to obtain a higher internal fibrillation than other laboratory refiners [1]. These efects of the PFI refining on cellulosic fibers will improve the accessibility, the swelling, the flexibility, and the inter-fiber bonding capacity of fibers.\n\n[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction\n[原文]\n It is assumed that these changes in the macro-level structure and properties are related to the changes of crystallinity and H-bonding network during refining [7,8].\n\nThere are some diferent conclusions regarding to the efects of PFI refining on crystallinity of cellulose, not like that of ball milling, which efectively reduces the crystallinity as the treatment progresses. Although some researchers considered that the crystallinity decreased during PFI refining for corn stover [9] or softwood pulp [10], some researchers reported that the crystallinity increased first and then decreased with the degree of refining for hardwood bleached kraft pulp fibers [11] or for unbleached eucalyptus fibers [12]. Moreover, Zhao et al. [7] reported that the crystallinity initially fluctuated upward and then downward, followed by a repeating fluctuation with PFI refining for tobacco stem mechanical pulp. None of the previous studies identified a clear trend, but the results were that the crystallinity varied during PFI refinement. Based on the large proportion of H-bonds in crystalline region of cellulose, it can be assumed that the H-bonding network might change during PFI refining.\n\n[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction\n[原文]\nFourier transformation infrared spectroscopy (FT-IR), which is sensitive to molecular structure, can be as an indirect measurement for studying H-bonding network. FT-IR deconvolution of hydroxyl groups band was adopted in order to study the changes of the energy of H-bonds and the H-bonding distance during delignification [13] or the deconstruction of cellulose [14]. Moreover, it was used to study the diferences of the content of H-bonds not only between dislocation region and normal region [15], but also among plant species [16,17]. Regarding the changes of H-bonding network during PFI refining, Yuan et al. [18] reported that the content of H-bonds and crystallinity index (CI) of eucalyptus fibers changed with the increment of beating time. Subsequently, Zhao et al. [8] found that the H-bonding energy for O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) inter-molecular H-bonds decreased by 12.9% and evolutions of the content of certain H-bonds difered at various refining stages.\n\n[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction\n[原文]\nThere is still a lack of literature on the efects of PFI refinement on the H-bonding network. Particularly, the relationship between the content of H-bonds and crystallinity is still worthy of further study, which will deepen the understanding of the molecular aggregation and distribution of H-bonds, providing a molecular-scale explanation for the variations in accessibility, swelling, flexibility, and fibrillation of cellulosic fibers during PFI refinement. Therefore, this work explored the efects of PFI refinement on the CI, crystallite size, energy of H-bonds, H-bonding distance, and content of H-bonds for softwood pulp fibers and hardwood pulp fibers. Attempts were made in order to establish the correlations between the CI and content of various H-bonds.",

  "arm": "astra",
  "task_id": "PFI2-020",
  "result_sha256": "55402a8349ed1a089f3995d1907531e287e9bbad904685356037aa80f14ffe95",
  "grader_input_sha256": "12fc797329ab1698e1327b4b1067e3df1b0c23fea40a9da228007f81200b7746",
  "raw_review_sha256": "02dd0801f660b4fda20ac68e64e482b2547baec01be874549eea99c05f0c9765",
  "summary": "能量/距离基本稳定与组分相对比例变化应区分；原文的机制推测不自动证明全部网络连接或同时发生的微观过程。",
  "evidence_checked": [
    "E17",
    "E18",
    "E19",
    "actual_claims_and_attached_citations"
  ],
  "changes": []
}

DeepSeek Flash · High

PFI 打浆过程中，O(6)H···O(3′)、O(3)H···O(5) 和 O(2)H···O(6) 三种氢键的峰位几乎不变，因此由峰位计算出的氢键能量和氢键距离基本不变。 [1]
但这只说明各类型氢键的局部能量和距离参数稳定；论文摘要同时指出，打浆后各种氢键的含量会发生变化。 [2]
Table 2 显示 softwood 纤维的 O(6)H···O(3′) 相对含量从 0 r 的 28.23% 降至 16,000 r 的 23.56%，而 O(3)H···O(5) 从 28.44% 升至 34.92%。 [3]
总体而言，softwood 和 hardwood 纤维的 O(6)H···O(3′) 含量分别下降 16.54% 和 5.91%，O(3)H···O(5) 含量分别增加 22.78% 和 8.8%。 [1]
游离 OH(2) 和 OH(6) 的含量也随打浆变化，作者将其归因于氢键断裂以及新氢键（如 O(2)H···O(6) 或 O(6)H···O(3′)）的形成。 [3]
O(6)H···O(3′) 含量与 CI-XI 的 Pearson 相关系数为 softwood 0.912、hardwood 0.889（p<0.05），表明氢键含量变化与结晶度变化相关。 [5]

要点：Jev 100.00% → 最终 100.00%；边界 2/2。

复核结论：能量/距离基本稳定与组分相对比例变化应区分；原文的机制推测不自动证明全部网络连接或同时发生的微观过程。

  {

    "page_end": 10,
    "text": "[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 3. Results and Discussions > 3.3. Efect of PFI Refining on H-Bonding Energies, H-Bonding Distances, and Content of H-Bonds\n[原文]\nA mixture of inter-molecular and intra-molecular H-bonds is considered to be the cause for the broadening of OH bands in the FT-IR spectra. Therefore, taking derivative of the OH bands can improve the resolution of various H-bonds. PFI2-024 · PFI打浆是怎么一步步让纸变结实的？纤维长度、细小纤维、WRV这几个因素里哪个贡献最大？

参考答案与评分要点
本文将PFI打浆与细纤维化、孔隙/新表面和WRV增加联系起来，膨胀后的纤维更柔顺，结合能力改善，纸页抗张性能提高；零距结果表明纤维强度未降低。论文没有提供各纤维因素独立贡献的排名或控制其他因素后的效应大小，不能把这些定性解释直接变成因果贡献率。

GPT-6 Astra · High

PFI打浆的作用包括：纤维壁内部被剥离、松解并溶胀（内原纤化）；纤维表面原纤维被剥离但仍附着（外原纤化）；剪切会使纤维变短，并形成细小纤维。 [2]
原纤化会增加纤维表面和孔隙，打浆程度提高时WRV也显著上升；溶胀让纤维横向更柔顺，有助于增强纤维间结合，研究观察到纸页拉伸强度提高。 [1] [2]
纤维长度会随打浆下降；对湿纸页强度而言，研究特别指出纤维长度发挥重要作用。研究同时报告，PFI打浆没有降低纤维本身的强度。 [1]
因此不能据此断定纤维长度、细小纤维或WRV哪一个对纸张强度的总体贡献最大：材料说明了各自变化及作用，但没有给出三者独立贡献的定量比较；若只问湿纸页强度，纤维长度是文中明确强调的因素。 [1]

要点：Jev 100.00% → 最终 100.00%；边界 2/2。

复核结论：工艺—形态/WRV—结合—纸页强度链条及零距区分基本齐全，未提供虚构贡献率；额外“联系最直接”等排序语句仍须有支持。

    "text": "[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction\n[原文]\nMechanical, chemical, and biological treatments are usually adopted to obtain the desired physical and mechanical properties and for further utilization of the natural cellulosic fibers. Therein, Papirindustriens forskningsinstitut (PFI) refining is the most common laboratory refiner in order to improve the inter-fiber bonding capacity [1] and accessibility [2,3], and manufacture the micro-fibrillated or nano-fibrillated cellulose [4–6]. The main efects of PFI refining on fibers are: (i) internal fibrillation—delaminating, loosening, and swelling of fiber wall; (ii) external fibrillation—peeling of fibrils from the fiber surface while remaining attached; (iii) fiber shortening—fiber cutting due to shearing action, and (iv) fines formation—primary fines come from ray cells and parenchyma cells and microfibrils that are caused by fiber shortening or external fibrillation. Moreover, the PFI refining could be adopted to obtain a higher internal fibrillation than other laboratory refiners [1]. These efects of the PFI refining on cellulosic fibers will improve the accessibility, the swelling, the flexibility, and the inter-fiber bonding capacity of fibers.\n\n[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction\n[原文]\n It is assumed that these changes in the macro-level structure and properties are related to the changes of crystallinity and H-bonding network during refining [7,8].\n\nThere are some diferent conclusions regarding to the efects of PFI refining on crystallinity of cellulose, not like that of ball milling, which efectively reduces the crystallinity as the treatment progresses. Although some researchers considered that the crystallinity decreased during PFI refining for corn stover [9] or softwood pulp [10], some researchers reported that the crystallinity increased first and then decreased with the degree of refining for hardwood bleached kraft pulp fibers [11] or for unbleached eucalyptus fibers [12]. Moreover, Zhao et al. [7] reported that the crystallinity initially fluctuated upward and then downward, followed by a repeating fluctuation with PFI refining for tobacco stem mechanical pulp. None of the previous studies identified a clear trend, but the results were that the crystallinity varied during PFI refinement. Based on the large proportion of H-bonds in crystalline region of cellulose, it can be assumed that the H-bonding network might change during PFI refining.\n\n[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction\n[原文]\nFourier transformation infrared spectroscopy (FT-IR), which is sensitive to molecular structure, can be as an indirect measurement for studying H-bonding network. FT-IR deconvolution of hydroxyl groups band was adopted in order to study the changes of the energy of H-bonds and the H-bonding distance during delignification [13] or the deconstruction of cellulose [14]. Moreover, it was used to study the diferences of the content of H-bonds not only between dislocation region and normal region [15], but also among plant species [16,17]. Regarding the changes of H-bonding network during PFI refining, Yuan et al. [18] reported that the content of H-bonds and crystallinity index (CI) of eucalyptus fibers changed with the increment of beating time. Subsequently, Zhao et al. [8] found that the H-bonding energy for O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) inter-molecular H-bonds decreased by 12.9% and evolutions of the content of certain H-bonds difered at various refining stages.\n\n[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction\n[原文]\nThere is still a lack of literature on the efects of PFI refinement on the H-bonding network. Particularly, the relationship between the content of H-bonds and crystallinity is still worthy of further study, which will deepen the understanding of the molecular aggregation and distribution of H-bonds, providing a molecular-scale explanation for the variations in accessibility, swelling, flexibility, and fibrillation of cellulosic fibers during PFI refinement. Therefore, this work explored the efects of PFI refinement on the CI, crystallite size, energy of H-bonds, H-bonding distance, and content of H-bonds for softwood pulp fibers and hardwood pulp fibers. Attempts were made in order to establish the correlations between the CI and content of various H-bonds.",

DeepSeek Flash · High

PFI打浆对纤维的主要作用包括内部细纤维化（细胞壁分层、松弛和润胀）、外部细纤维化（表面微细纤维剥离但仍附着）、纤维切断和细小纤维生成。 [2]
这些作用会提高纤维的可及性、润胀性、柔顺性和纤维间结合能力，从而为成纸强度提高提供基础。 [2]
随PFI转数增加，打浆度和WRV显著升高；文中归因于细纤维化产生新的表面和更多孔隙。 [1]
WRV表征的润胀增加使纤维在横向更柔顺，这有助于提高纤维网络的纤维间结合强度。 [1]
Figure 1显示，PFI打浆后软木浆的纤维长度下降，而细小纤维含量上升，同时宏观细纤维化指数上升。 [1]
PFI打浆提高了细纤维化程度（尤其是内部细纤维化）、纤维润胀和纸页拉伸强度，且零-span结果说明未降低单根纤维强度。 [1]
分子层面，O(6)H···O(3′)分子间氢键总量在打浆中下降，且更少的分子间氢键和较低结晶指数有利于提高纤维柔顺性、可及性和WRV。 [3]
湿纸幅强度方面，软木浆的增加比硬木浆更显著，作者强调纤维长度对湿纸幅强度起重要作用。 [1]
所给证据没有给出纤维长度、细小纤维和WRV三者对成纸强度贡献的定量排序；从直接论述看，WRV/润胀（内部细纤维化）与纤维间结合强度的联系最直接，而纤维长度主要被强调为湿纸幅强度的关键因素。 [1] [2]

要点：Jev 100.00% → 最终 100.00%；边界 2/2。

复核结论：工艺—形态/WRV—结合—纸页强度链条及零距区分基本齐全，未提供虚构贡献率；额外“联系最直接”等排序语句仍须有支持。

    {
      "id": "C1",
      "text": "PFI打浆对纤维的主要作用包括内部细纤维化（细胞壁分层、松弛和润胀）、外部细纤维化（表面微细纤维剥离但仍附着）、纤维切断和细小纤维生成。",
      "claim_type": "fact",
      "support": "supported",
      "basis_locator": "B032",
      "basis": {
        "type": "paper_text",
        "text": "o improve the inter-fiber bonding capacity [ 1 ] and accessibility [ 2 , 3 ], and manufacture the micro-fibrillated or nano-fibrillated cellulose [ 4 , 5 , 6 ]. The main effects of PFI refining on fibers are: (i) internal fibrillation—delaminating, loosening, and swelling of fiber wall; (ii) external fibrillation—peeling of fibrils from the fiber surface while remaining attached; (iii) fiber shortening—fiber cutting due to shearing action, and (iv) fines formation—primary fines come from ray cells and parenchyma cells and microfibrils that are caused by fiber shortening or external fibrillation. Moreover, the PFI refining could be adopted to obtain a higher internal fibrillation than other laboratory refiners [ 1 ]. These effects of the PFI refining on cellulosic fibers will improve the accessibility, the swelling, the flexibility, and the inter-fiber bonding capacity of fibers. It is assumed that these changes in the macro-level structure and properties are related to the changes of c",
        "document_id": "doc_0fcf2a50cfa02d21",
        "start": 3000,
        "end": 4000
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "C2",
      "text": "这些作用会提高纤维的可及性、润胀性、柔顺性和纤维间结合能力，从而为成纸强度提高提供基础。",
      "claim_type": "fact",
      "support": "supported",
      "basis_locator": "B032",
      "basis": {
        "type": "paper_text",
        "text": "o improve the inter-fiber bonding capacity [ 1 ] and accessibility [ 2 , 3 ], and manufacture the micro-fibrillated or nano-fibrillated cellulose [ 4 , 5 , 6 ]. The main effects of PFI refining on fibers are: (i) internal fibrillation—delaminating, loosening, and swelling of fiber wall; (ii) external fibrillation—peeling of fibrils from the fiber surface while remaining attached; (iii) fiber shortening—fiber cutting due to shearing action, and (iv) fines formation—primary fines come from ray cells and parenchyma cells and microfibrils that are caused by fiber shortening or external fibrillation. Moreover, the PFI refining could be adopted to obtain a higher internal fibrillation than other laboratory refiners [ 1 ]. These effects of the PFI refining on cellulosic fibers will improve the accessibility, the swelling, the flexibility, and the inter-fiber bonding capacity of fibers. It is assumed that these changes in the macro-level structure and properties are related to the changes of c",
        "document_id": "doc_0fcf2a50cfa02d21",
        "start": 3000,
        "end": 4000
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "C3",
      "text": "随PFI转数增加，打浆度和WRV显著升高；文中归因于细纤维化产生新的表面和更多孔隙。",
      "claim_type": "fact",
      "support": "supported",
      "basis_locator": "E13",
      "basis": {
        "type": "reference_evidence",
        "text": "The beating degree and the WRV had a significant increment with increasing PFI refining revolutions, as can be seen in Figure 2. It is caused by the higher fibrillation that produces the new surface and more pores (as shown in Table S1 in Online Resource). The increase in swelling characterized by WRV makes the fibers more compliant in transverse [1], which contributes to improving the inter-fiber bonding strength of the fiber network. The results of fiber morphology analysis and water retention value showing that the fibrillation and the separation between fibrils increase with the refining process."
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "C4",
      "text": "WRV表征的润胀增加使纤维在横向更柔顺，这有助于提高纤维网络的纤维间结合强度。",
      "claim_type": "fact",
      "support": "supported",
      "basis_locator": "E13",
      "basis": {
        "type": "reference_evidence",
        "text": "The beating degree and the WRV had a significant increment with increasing PFI refining revolutions, as can be seen in Figure 2. The increase in swelling characterized by WRV makes the fibers more compliant in transverse [1], which contributes to improving the inter-fiber bonding strength of the fiber network. The results of fiber morphology analysis and water retention value showing that the fibrillation and the separation between fibrils increase with the refining process."
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "C5",
      "text": "Figure 1显示，PFI打浆后软木浆的纤维长度下降，而细小纤维含量上升，同时宏观细纤维化指数上升。",
      "claim_type": "fact",
      "support": "supported",
      "basis_locator": "E12",
      "basis": {
        "type": "reference_evidence",
        "text": "For softwood fibers and hardwood fibers, the macro-fibrillation index and the fiber length had a downward trend, and the fines content has an upward trend for the softwood fibers during PFI refining, as can be seen in Figure 1. The macro-fibrillation index and fiber length of softwood fibers changed significantly. However, two parameters of hardwood fibers had no significant variations relative to softwood fibers. It might be because of the lower refining pressure that was applied in hardwood fibers. The macro-fibrillation index characterizes external macro-fibrillation. The results of fiber morphology analysis showed that external fibrillation increased with the refining process. It is consistent with the increasing specific surface area (as shown in Table S1 in Online Resource)."
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "C6",
      "text": "PFI打浆提高了细纤维化程度（尤其是内部细纤维化）、纤维润胀和纸页拉伸强度，且零-span结果说明未降低单根纤维强度。",
      "claim_type": "fact",
      "support": "supported",
      "basis_locator": "E14",
      "basis": {
        "type": "reference_evidence",
        "text": "In Figure 3, the tensile index, zero-span tensile index, and wet-web strength represented as a function of the refining revolutions. The increment of tensile strength is mainly caused by the increasing fibrillation and fines during PFI refining, as mentioned above. The wet–web strength of softwood fiber had a more significant increase when compared to that of hardwood fiber. It is for that fiber length plays an essential role in wet–web strength. The zero-span tensile index was usually used in characterizing the tensile strength of fibers. The results of the zero-span tensile index showed that PFI refining did not reduce fiber strength, which is consistent with the report of Kouko et al. [24]. The above results showed that PFI refining improved the extent of fibrillation (especially the internal fibrillation), the swelling of fibers, and the tensile strength of sheets without a decrease of the tensile strength of fibers."
      }
    },

The decrease might be due to the cleavage among cellulose molecular chains under the mechanical action of PFI refining, which was closely related to internal and external fibrillation (as seen in Section 3.1 ). On the other hand, the increase illustrates that there was not only the breakage, but also the formation of O(6)H⋯O(3′) H-bonds. Both the fewer inter-molecular H-bonds and the lower CI (as Section 3.2 shows) will further improve the flexibility of cellulosic fibers, due to the higher mobility of molecular chains, the accessibility, and the WRV of fibers (as seen in Section 3.1 ).     "text": "[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction\n[原文]\nMechanical, chemical, and biological treatments are usually adopted to obtain the desired physical and mechanical properties and for further utilization of the natural cellulosic fibers. Therein, Papirindustriens forskningsinstitut (PFI) refining is the most common laboratory refiner in order to improve the inter-fiber bonding capacity [1] and accessibility [2,3], and manufacture the micro-fibrillated or nano-fibrillated cellulose [4–6]. The main efects of PFI refining on fibers are: (i) internal fibrillation—delaminating, loosening, and swelling of fiber wall; (ii) external fibrillation—peeling of fibrils from the fiber surface while remaining attached; (iii) fiber shortening—fiber cutting due to shearing action, and (iv) fines formation—primary fines come from ray cells and parenchyma cells and microfibrils that are caused by fiber shortening or external fibrillation. Moreover, the PFI refining could be adopted to obtain a higher internal fibrillation than other laboratory refiners [1]. These efects of the PFI refining on cellulosic fibers will improve the accessibility, the swelling, the flexibility, and the inter-fiber bonding capacity of fibers.\n\n[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction\n[原文]\n It is assumed that these changes in the macro-level structure and properties are related to the changes of crystallinity and H-bonding network during refining [7,8].\n\nThere are some diferent conclusions regarding to the efects of PFI refining on crystallinity of cellulose, not like that of ball milling, which efectively reduces the crystallinity as the treatment progresses. Although some researchers considered that the crystallinity decreased during PFI refining for corn stover [9] or softwood pulp [10], some researchers reported that the crystallinity increased first and then decreased with the degree of refining for hardwood bleached kraft pulp fibers [11] or for unbleached eucalyptus fibers [12]. Moreover, Zhao et al. [7] reported that the crystallinity initially fluctuated upward and then downward, followed by a repeating fluctuation with PFI refining for tobacco stem mechanical pulp. None of the previous studies identified a clear trend, but the results were that the crystallinity varied during PFI refinement. Based on the large proportion of H-bonds in crystalline region of cellulose, it can be assumed that the H-bonding network might change during PFI refining.\n\n[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction\n[原文]\nFourier transformation infrared spectroscopy (FT-IR), which is sensitive to molecular structure, can be as an indirect measurement for studying H-bonding network. FT-IR deconvolution of hydroxyl groups band was adopted in order to study the changes of the energy of H-bonds and the H-bonding distance during delignification [13] or the deconstruction of cellulose [14]. Moreover, it was used to study the diferences of the content of H-bonds not only between dislocation region and normal region [15], but also among plant species [16,17]. Regarding the changes of H-bonding network during PFI refining, Yuan et al. [18] reported that the content of H-bonds and crystallinity index (CI) of eucalyptus fibers changed with the increment of beating time. Subsequently, Zhao et al. [8] found that the H-bonding energy for O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) inter-molecular H-bonds decreased by 12.9% and evolutions of the content of certain H-bonds difered at various refining stages.\n\n[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction\n[原文]\nThere is still a lack of literature on the efects of PFI refinement on the H-bonding network. Particularly, the relationship between the content of H-bonds and crystallinity is still worthy of further study, which will deepen the understanding of the molecular aggregation and distribution of H-bonds, providing a molecular-scale explanation for the variations in accessibility, swelling, flexibility, and fibrillation of cellulosic fibers during PFI refinement. Therefore, this work explored the efects of PFI refinement on the CI, crystallite size, energy of H-bonds, H-bonding distance, and content of H-bonds for softwood pulp fibers and hardwood pulp fibers. Attempts were made in order to establish the correlations between the CI and content of various H-bonds.",

The decrease might be due to the cleavage among cellulose molecular chains under the mechanical action of PFI refining, which was closely related to internal and external fibrillation (as seen in Section 3.1). On the other hand, the increase illustrates that there was not only the breakage, but also the formation of O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) H-bonds. Both the fewer inter-molecular H-bonds and the lower CI (as Section 3.2 shows) will further improve the flexibility of cellulosic fibers, due to the higher mobility of molecular chains, the accessibility, and the WRV of fibers (as seen in Section 3.1).\n\n[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 3. Overall, the trend was similar to that of hardwood fibers, which first increased and then had a decrease, followed by a growth. During the whole refining, the amount of $\\mathrm { O } ( 3 ) \\mathrm { H } \\cdots \\mathrm { O } ( 5 )$ H-bonds for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers showed an upward tendency and increased by 22.78% and 8.8%, respectively. The increase might be because the stable O(3)H· · · O(5) H-bonds might have not only less breakage under the action of water as destructor to the crystallites [30], but also creation in the amorphous region upon drying. Because hydrogen bond–covalent bond synergies play an important role in the cellulose stifness axial modulus, more O(3)H· · · O(5) H-bonds will enhance the cellulose stifness [33,34].\n\n[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 3. For the content of the O(2)H· · · O(6) H-bonds of hardwood fiber, it increased firstly and then had a decrease that was also followed by an increase. It might be due to the fact that the O(2)H· · · O(6) H-bonds, which are much more accessible to water, are less stable than O(3)H· · · O(5) H-bonds.\n\n[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 3. However, for the free OH(2) and OH(6) of hardwood fiber, the number of the free OH(2) and OH(6) decreased by 21.65% from 14.32% to 11.22%, with revolutions increasing from 0 r to 4000 r, followed by an increase of 45.37% in the stage of refining from 4000 r to 12,000 r, along with an decrease of 17.11%. It could be explained by the instability of free OH groups, which makes it easy to form new H-bonds, such as O(2)H· · · O(6) or O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>)H-bonds. Thus although there is the formation of free OH(2) and OH(6) during fibrillation, the content of the free OH(2) and OH(6) might disease; meanwhile, the content of the O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) or the O(2)H· · · O(6) H-bonds might increase upon drying.",

The increment of tensile strength is mainly caused by the increasing fibrillation and fines during PFI refining, as mentioned above. PFI精磨在提高纸页抗张强度的同时，没有降低纤维本身的强度；零距抗张指数结果支持这一结论。 [4] [5]
当前提供的证据仅给出了抗张指数、湿纸幅强度和零距抗张指数等信息，未提供同一批样品的耐破指数和撕裂指数精确数值，因此无法据此准确列出这两项数据。 [1] [2] [5]

DeepSeek Flash · High

论文的结论是：PFI精炼提高了纤维细纤维化（尤其是内部细纤维化）、纤维润胀和纸页抗张强度，且未降低纤维本身的抗张强度。 [4]
论文将干纸页抗张强度的提高主要归因于PFI精炼过程中细纤维化和细组分（fines）的增加。 [4]
Figure 3显示，随PFI精炼转数增加，软木和硬木样品的干纸页抗张指数均呈上升趋势。 [2]
所提供证据中的力学性能图仅包含干纸页抗张指数、零-span抗张指数和湿纸幅强度，没有耐破指数或撕裂指数数据。 [1] [2]
因此，无法根据所给证据给出同一批样品的耐破指数和撕裂指数精确数值。 [1] [2]

要点：Jev 未能有效评分 → 最终 100.00%；边界 2/2。

复核结论：应答的抗张结论和不能提供的耐破/撕裂数值均处理；图3真实支持图中曲线，图2不能充当抗张或零距证据。纯缺失声明按scope检查。

GPT-6 Astra · High

所给证据均来自PFI精磨论文，未提供《Non-Wood Fibers: Relationships of Fiber Properties with Pulp Properties》的实验数据，因此无法完成“全部实验数据”的可靠比较，也无法确认两篇论文的共同结论。 [1] [2] [3] [6] [7]
就PFI论文自身而言，随着精磨转数增加，纤维原纤化、WRV和纸页抗张性能总体提高；零距抗张指数未显示纤维强度下降。 [2]
PFI论文还表明，精磨会使结晶指数发生波动并总体略有下降，但纤维素晶型未改变，晶粒尺寸和各种氢键含量总体变化不大，因此其主要表现为原纤化而非对超分子结构的剧烈破坏。 [3] [6] [7]

要点：Jev 100.00% → 最终 100.00%；边界 2/2。

复核结论：两侧均明确缺少第二篇资料，未虚构跨文献共同结论。纯资料范围声明的引用分不适用，不能把其原始未支持标签算成科学事实引用错误。

    "text": "[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction\n[原文]\nMechanical, chemical, and biological treatments are usually adopted to obtain the desired physical and mechanical properties and for further utilization of the natural cellulosic fibers. Therein, Papirindustriens forskningsinstitut (PFI) refining is the most common laboratory refiner in order to improve the inter-fiber bonding capacity [1] and accessibility [2,3], and manufacture the micro-fibrillated or nano-fibrillated cellulose [4–6]. The main efects of PFI refining on fibers are: (i) internal fibrillation—delaminating, loosening, and swelling of fiber wall; (ii) external fibrillation—peeling of fibrils from the fiber surface while remaining attached; (iii) fiber shortening—fiber cutting due to shearing action, and (iv) fines formation—primary fines come from ray cells and parenchyma cells and microfibrils that are caused by fiber shortening or external fibrillation. Moreover, the PFI refining could be adopted to obtain a higher internal fibrillation than other laboratory refiners [1]. These efects of the PFI refining on cellulosic fibers will improve the accessibility, the swelling, the flexibility, and the inter-fiber bonding capacity of fibers.\n\n[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction\n[原文]\n It is assumed that these changes in the macro-level structure and properties are related to the changes of crystallinity and H-bonding network during refining [7,8].\n\nThere are some diferent conclusions regarding to the efects of PFI refining on crystallinity of cellulose, not like that of ball milling, which efectively reduces the crystallinity as the treatment progresses. Although some researchers considered that the crystallinity decreased during PFI refining for corn stover [9] or softwood pulp [10], some researchers reported that the crystallinity increased first and then decreased with the degree of refining for hardwood bleached kraft pulp fibers [11] or for unbleached eucalyptus fibers [12]. Moreover, Zhao et al. [7] reported that the crystallinity initially fluctuated upward and then downward, followed by a repeating fluctuation with PFI refining for tobacco stem mechanical pulp. None of the previous studies identified a clear trend, but the results were that the crystallinity varied during PFI refinement. Based on the large proportion of H-bonds in crystalline region of cellulose, it can be assumed that the H-bonding network might change during PFI refining.\n\n[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction\n[原文]\nFourier transformation infrared spectroscopy (FT-IR), which is sensitive to molecular structure, can be as an indirect measurement for studying H-bonding network. FT-IR deconvolution of hydroxyl groups band was adopted in order to study the changes of the energy of H-bonds and the H-bonding distance during delignification [13] or the deconstruction of cellulose [14]. Moreover, it was used to study the diferences of the content of H-bonds not only between dislocation region and normal region [15], but also among plant species [16,17]. Regarding the changes of H-bonding network during PFI refining, Yuan et al. [18] reported that the content of H-bonds and crystallinity index (CI) of eucalyptus fibers changed with the increment of beating time. Subsequently, Zhao et al. [8] found that the H-bonding energy for O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) inter-molecular H-bonds decreased by 12.9% and evolutions of the content of certain H-bonds difered at various refining stages.\n\n[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction\n[原文]\nThere is still a lack of literature on the efects of PFI refinement on the H-bonding network. Particularly, the relationship between the content of H-bonds and crystallinity is still worthy of further study, which will deepen the understanding of the molecular aggregation and distribution of H-bonds, providing a molecular-scale explanation for the variations in accessibility, swelling, flexibility, and fibrillation of cellulosic fibers during PFI refinement. Therefore, this work explored the efects of PFI refinement on the CI, crystallite size, energy of H-bonds, H-bonding distance, and content of H-bonds for softwood pulp fibers and hardwood pulp fibers. Attempts were made in order to establish the correlations between the CI and content of various H-bonds.",

Conclusions\n[原文]\nThe results indicated that the fibrillation and properties of fibers are related to the variation of the supramolecular structure during PFI refining. It is noticeable that there was a significantly positive correlation between the CI-XI and content of O(6)H· · · O(3)’ H-bonds during PFI refining for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers. Thus, the trend of the content of O(6)H· · · O(3)’ H-bonds might be generally speculated based on CI-XI while refining. Besides, the crystallite size, crystallinity, and content of various H-bonds did not change much in general. It is assumed that PFI refining is an excellent mechanical treatment of fibrillation with relatively little destruction on the supramolecular structure.",

Subsequently, the growth of the CI could be interpreted as greater force acting on the amorphous region in which cocrystallization might occur upon drying under the mechanical and thermal action of PFI refining.     "text": "[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction\n[原文]\nMechanical, chemical, and biological treatments are usually adopted to obtain the desired physical and mechanical properties and for further utilization of the natural cellulosic fibers. Therein, Papirindustriens forskningsinstitut (PFI) refining is the most common laboratory refiner in order to improve the inter-fiber bonding capacity [1] and accessibility [2,3], and manufacture the micro-fibrillated or nano-fibrillated cellulose [4–6]. The main efects of PFI refining on fibers are: (i) internal fibrillation—delaminating, loosening, and swelling of fiber wall; (ii) external fibrillation—peeling of fibrils from the fiber surface while remaining attached; (iii) fiber shortening—fiber cutting due to shearing action, and (iv) fines formation—primary fines come from ray cells and parenchyma cells and microfibrils that are caused by fiber shortening or external fibrillation. Moreover, the PFI refining could be adopted to obtain a higher internal fibrillation than other laboratory refiners [1]. These efects of the PFI refining on cellulosic fibers will improve the accessibility, the swelling, the flexibility, and the inter-fiber bonding capacity of fibers.\n\n[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction\n[原文]\n It is assumed that these changes in the macro-level structure and properties are related to the changes of crystallinity and H-bonding network during refining [7,8].\n\nThere are some diferent conclusions regarding to the efects of PFI refining on crystallinity of cellulose, not like that of ball milling, which efectively reduces the crystallinity as the treatment progresses. Although some researchers considered that the crystallinity decreased during PFI refining for corn stover [9] or softwood pulp [10], some researchers reported that the crystallinity increased first and then decreased with the degree of refining for hardwood bleached kraft pulp fibers [11] or for unbleached eucalyptus fibers [12]. Moreover, Zhao et al. [7] reported that the crystallinity initially fluctuated upward and then downward, followed by a repeating fluctuation with PFI refining for tobacco stem mechanical pulp. None of the previous studies identified a clear trend, but the results were that the crystallinity varied during PFI refinement. Based on the large proportion of H-bonds in crystalline region of cellulose, it can be assumed that the H-bonding network might change during PFI refining.\n\n[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction\n[原文]\nFourier transformation infrared spectroscopy (FT-IR), which is sensitive to molecular structure, can be as an indirect measurement for studying H-bonding network. FT-IR deconvolution of hydroxyl groups band was adopted in order to study the changes of the energy of H-bonds and the H-bonding distance during delignification [13] or the deconstruction of cellulose [14]. Moreover, it was used to study the diferences of the content of H-bonds not only between dislocation region and normal region [15], but also among plant species [16,17]. Regarding the changes of H-bonding network during PFI refining, Yuan et al. [18] reported that the content of H-bonds and crystallinity index (CI) of eucalyptus fibers changed with the increment of beating time. Subsequently, Zhao et al. [8] found that the H-bonding energy for O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) inter-molecular H-bonds decreased by 12.9% and evolutions of the content of certain H-bonds difered at various refining stages.\n\n[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction\n[原文]\nThere is still a lack of literature on the efects of PFI refinement on the H-bonding network. Particularly, the relationship between the content of H-bonds and crystallinity is still worthy of further study, which will deepen the understanding of the molecular aggregation and distribution of H-bonds, providing a molecular-scale explanation for the variations in accessibility, swelling, flexibility, and fibrillation of cellulosic fibers during PFI refinement. Therefore, this work explored the efects of PFI refinement on the CI, crystallite size, energy of H-bonds, H-bonding distance, and content of H-bonds for softwood pulp fibers and hardwood pulp fibers. Attempts were made in order to establish the correlations between the CI and content of various H-bonds.",
