    "text": "[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 4. Conclusions\n[原文]\nupramolecular structure, including crystallite size, crystallinity, and content of various H-bonds.PFI refining acts not only on the macro-level structure and mechanical properties, but also on The results indicated that the fibrillation and properties of fibers are related to the variation of thethe supramolecular structure, including crystallite size, crystallinity, and content of various H-bonds.\n\n[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 4. Conclusions\n[原文]\nThe results indicated that the fibrillation and properties of fibers are related to the variation of the supramolecular structure during PFI refining. It is noticeable that there was a significantly positive correlation between the CI-XI and content of O(6)H· · · O(3)’ H-bonds during PFI refining for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers. Thus, the trend of the content of O(6)H· · · O(3)’ H-bonds might be generally speculated based on CI-XI while refining. 表 2 中的 r²（约 0.9989–0.9996）是氢键分峰/非线性拟合的拟合优度，不是预测模型在验证集上的 R²。 [1]
所给证据中未出现验证集 RMSE，也未给出任何已训练纸张抗张预测模型及其最佳模型名称。 [1] [2] [4]

要点：Jev 100.00% → 最终 100.00%；边界 2/2。

In the first refining stage, the decrease of the CI showed that mechanical treatment may mainly act in the crystalline region. Subsequently, the growth of the CI could be interpreted as greater force acting on the amorphous region in which cocrystallization might occur upon drying under the mechanical and thermal action of PFI refining. DeepSeek Flash · High

所给证据并不支持“阔叶木打浆后湿纸幅强度增幅高于针叶木”；原文明确说针叶木湿纸幅强度的增加比阔叶木更显著。 [1]
作者将这种差异归因于纤维长度：纤维长度对湿纸幅强度起关键作用。 [1]
阔叶木的 macro-fibrillation index 和纤维长度相对针叶木没有显著变化，原因可能是阔叶木打浆时施加的 refining pressure 较低。 [1]
方法部分给出的 PFI 每 bar 长度作用力为针叶木 3.33 N/mm、阔叶木 1.77 N/mm，表明阔叶木受到的打浆作用较弱。 [2]
打浆会提高 beating degree 和 WRV，细纤维化产生新表面和更多孔隙，并改善纤维网络的 inter-fiber bonding；但这些变化在该研究中未使阔叶木湿纸幅强度增幅超过针叶木。 [1]

要点：Jev 100.00% → 最终 100.00%；边界 2/2。

复核结论：两侧均纠正湿纸幅增幅的错误前提；实际Figure 1还支持针叶木更长，不能仅因文字没有精确长度而否定图文事实。

PFI2-031 · PFI打浆把纤维素从I型变成II型以后，结晶度为什么还会下降？

参考答案与评分要点
前提不成立：论文指出两种纤维的纤维素晶型在PFI处理中没有变化（依据附件XRD图S1、S2），作者据此认为PFI打浆是较温和的机械处理。结晶度方面，0→16000转总体下降但过程有波动，例如针叶木CI-XI由73.23%到69.82%。

GPT-6 Astra · High

首先需要纠正前提：该研究的XRD结果表明，PFI处理前后纤维素晶型没有改变，PFI被认为是相对温和的机械处理，因此不能据此说发生了纤维素I型到II型的转变。 [2]
PFI产生内部原纤化、外部原纤化、纤维切断和细小纤维形成；机械作用可直接作用于晶区，使晶区受到破坏，所以结晶度指数下降。 [1] [2]
打浆过程中纤维素分子链之间的氢键可能发生断裂，导致分层、比表面积和水可及性增加；这些结构变化会降低有序聚集程度，并与较低的结晶度相对应。 [4]
结晶度并不一定单调下降：初期可能因晶区先受作用而下降，随后无定形区在机械和热作用下干燥时发生一定程度的共结晶而回升，继续打浆后晶区持续破坏又使其下降。表中软木纤维的CI-XI由73.23%降至69.82%、CI-XA由40.46%降至34.20%，硬木纤维也呈总体下降。 [2] [3]
因此，若你的样品确实观察到纤维素I型向II型转变，现有证据只能说明PFI引起的结晶度下降机制，不能证明该晶型转变及其后续结晶度变化的具体原因。 [2]

要点：Jev 100.00% → 最终 100.00%；边界 1/2。

复核结论：两侧均纠正晶型I→II的错误前提；额外机制不能把可能解释写成确定因果，也不能把相对含量降幅当作绝对总量变化。

调整明细及证据

    "text": "[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction\n[原文]\nMechanical, chemical, and biological treatments are usually adopted to obtain the desired physical and mechanical properties and for further utilization of the natural cellulosic fibers. Therein, Papirindustriens forskningsinstitut (PFI) refining is the most common laboratory refiner in order to improve the inter-fiber bonding capacity [1] and accessibility [2,3], and manufacture the micro-fibrillated or nano-fibrillated cellulose [4–6]. The main efects of PFI refining on fibers are: (i) internal fibrillation—delaminating, loosening, and swelling of fiber wall; (ii) external fibrillation—peeling of fibrils from the fiber surface while remaining attached; (iii) fiber shortening—fiber cutting due to shearing action, and (iv) fines formation—primary fines come from ray cells and parenchyma cells and microfibrils that are caused by fiber shortening or external fibrillation. Moreover, the PFI refining could be adopted to obtain a higher internal fibrillation than other laboratory refiners [1]. These efects of the PFI refining on cellulosic fibers will improve the accessibility, the swelling, the flexibility, and the inter-fiber bonding capacity of fibers.\n\n[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction\n[原文]\n It is assumed that these changes in the macro-level structure and properties are related to the changes of crystallinity and H-bonding network during refining [7,8].\n\nThere are some diferent conclusions regarding to the efects of PFI refining on crystallinity of cellulose, not like that of ball milling, which efectively reduces the crystallinity as the treatment progresses. Although some researchers considered that the crystallinity decreased during PFI refining for corn stover [9] or softwood pulp [10], some researchers reported that the crystallinity increased first and then decreased with the degree of refining for hardwood bleached kraft pulp fibers [11] or for unbleached eucalyptus fibers [12]. Moreover, Zhao et al. [7] reported that the crystallinity initially fluctuated upward and then downward, followed by a repeating fluctuation with PFI refining for tobacco stem mechanical pulp. None of the previous studies identified a clear trend, but the results were that the crystallinity varied during PFI refinement. Based on the large proportion of H-bonds in crystalline region of cellulose, it can be assumed that the H-bonding network might change during PFI refining.\n\n[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction\n[原文]\nFourier transformation infrared spectroscopy (FT-IR), which is sensitive to molecular structure, can be as an indirect measurement for studying H-bonding network. FT-IR deconvolution of hydroxyl groups band was adopted in order to study the changes of the energy of H-bonds and the H-bonding distance during delignification [13] or the deconstruction of cellulose [14]. Moreover, it was used to study the diferences of the content of H-bonds not only between dislocation region and normal region [15], but also among plant species [16,17]. Regarding the changes of H-bonding network during PFI refining, Yuan et al. [18] reported that the content of H-bonds and crystallinity index (CI) of eucalyptus fibers changed with the increment of beating time. Subsequently, Zhao et al. [8] found that the H-bonding energy for O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) inter-molecular H-bonds decreased by 12.9% and evolutions of the content of certain H-bonds difered at various refining stages.\n\n[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction\n[原文]\nThere is still a lack of literature on the efects of PFI refinement on the H-bonding network. Particularly, the relationship between the content of H-bonds and crystallinity is still worthy of further study, which will deepen the understanding of the molecular aggregation and distribution of H-bonds, providing a molecular-scale explanation for the variations in accessibility, swelling, flexibility, and fibrillation of cellulosic fibers during PFI refinement. Therefore, this work explored the efects of PFI refinement on the CI, crystallite size, energy of H-bonds, H-bonding distance, and content of H-bonds for softwood pulp fibers and hardwood pulp fibers. Attempts were made in order to establish the correlations between the CI and content of various H-bonds.",

Efect of PFI Refining on H-Bonding Energies, H-Bonding Distances, and Content of H-Bonds\n[原文]\nFor the content of O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) inter-molecular H-bonds of softwood fiber, the trend can be <sup>For</sup> <sup>the</sup> <sup>content</sup> <sup>of</sup> <sup>O(6)H O(3′)</sup> <sup>inter-molecular</sup> <sup>H-bonds</sup> <sup>of</sup> <sup>softwood</sup> <sup>fiber,</sup> <sup>the</sup> <sup>trend</sup> <sup>can</sup> <sup>be</sup>divided into two stages, as shown in Table 2a. It decreased by 7.72% from 28.23% to 26.05% as refining from 0r to 4000 r and then increased by 9.14% from 4000 r to 8000 r, followed by a decrease of 17.13%, with the revolutions increasing from 8000 r to 16,000 r. Regarding the O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) H-bonds of <sup>with</sup> <sup>the</sup> <sup>revolutions</sup> <sup>increasing</sup> <sup>from</sup> <sup>8000</sup> <sup>r</sup> <sup>to</sup> <sup>16,000</sup> <sup>r.</sup> <sup>Regarding</sup> <sup>the</sup> <sup>O(6)H O(3′)</sup> <sup>H-bonds</sup> <sup>of</sup>hardwood fiber, the trend was almost similar to that of softwood fibers, except for a small increase of 0.45% from 8000 r to 12,000 r (in Table 2b).\n\n[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 3. Results and Discussions > 3.3. Efect of PFI Refining on H-Bonding Energies, H-Bonding Distances, and Content of H-Bonds\n[原文]\n On the whole, the amount of the O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) H-bonds for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers decreased by 16.54% and 5.91% altogether, respectively. The decrease might be due to the cleavage among cellulose molecular chains under the mechanical action of PFI refining, which was closely related to internal and external fibrillation (as seen in Section 3.1). On the other hand, the increase illustrates that there was not only the breakage, but also the formation of O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) H-bonds. Both the fewer inter-molecular H-bonds and the lower CI (as Section 3.2 shows) will further improve the flexibility of cellulosic fibers, due to the higher mobility of molecular chains, the accessibility, and the WRV of fibers (as seen in Section 3.1).\n\n[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 3. Results and Discussions > 3.3. Efect of PFI Refining on H-Bonding Energies, H-Bonding Distances, and Content of H-Bonds\n[原文]\nAs to the O(3)H· · · O(5) intra-molecular H-bonds of softwood fiber, the content had a growth of 10.09% from 28.44% to 31.31% in the stage of refining from 0 r to 4000 r, and then had a slight decrease of 1.44% from 4000 r to 8000 r, followed by an increase of 13.16% until the end of refining. Overall, the trend was similar to that of hardwood fibers, which first increased and then had a decrease, followed by a growth. During the whole refining, the amount of $\\mathrm { O } ( 3 ) \\mathrm { H } \\cdots \\mathrm { O } ( 5 )$ H-bonds for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers showed an upward tendency and increased by 22.78% and 8.8%, respectively. The increase might be because the stable O(3)H· · · O(5) H-bonds might have not only less breakage under the action of water as destructor to the crystallites [30], but also creation in the amorphous region upon drying. Because hydrogen bond–covalent bond synergies play an important role in the cellulose stifness axial modulus, more O(3)H· · · O(5) H-bonds will enhance the cellulose stifness [33,34].\n\n[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 3. Results and Discussions > 3.3. Efect of PFI Refining on H-Bonding Energies, H-Bonding Distances, and Content of H-Bonds\n[原文]\nIn the case of the O(2)H· · · O(6) intra-molecular H-bonds for softwood fiber, the trend of content can be described as two phases. It had an increase of 3.5% from 31.4% to 32.5% in the stage of refining from 0 r to 4000 r and it then decreased by 21.57% from 4000 r to 12000 r, along with a growth of 15.26% in the last refining stage. For the content of the O(2)H· · · O(6) H-bonds of hardwood fiber, it increased firstly and then had a decrease that was also followed by an increase. For both fibers, the content of O(2)H· · · O(6) H-bonds decreased, except for the stage of refining from 0 r to 4000 r. It might be due to the fact that the O(2)H· · · O(6) H-bonds, which are much more accessible to water, are less stable than O(3)H· · · O(5) H-bonds.\n\n[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 3. Results and Discussions > 3.3. Efect of PFI Refining on H-Bonding Energies, H-Bonding Distances, and Content of H-Bonds\n[原文]\nAs to the free OH(2) and OH(6) of softwood fiber, the relative content showed a slight increase trend in general. The enhancement of the free OH(2) and OH(6) was understandable, because there was the breakage of H-bonds among cellulosic molecules, which resulted in more extensive delamination and higher specific surface area (as shown in Figure S4 and Table S1 in Online Resource). This made cellulose more accessible to water and chemicals. However, for the free OH(2) and OH(6) of hardwood fiber, the number of the free OH(2) and OH(6) decreased by 21.65% from 14.32% to 11.22%, with revolutions increasing from 0 r to 4000 r, followed by an increase of 45.37% in the stage of refining from 4000 r to 12,000 r, along with an decrease of 17.11%. It could be explained by the instability of free OH groups, which makes it easy to form new H-bonds, such as O(2)H· · · O(6) or O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>)H-bonds. Thus although there is the formation of free OH(2) and OH(6) during fibrillation, the content of the free OH(2) and OH(6) might disease; meanwhile, the content of the O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) or the O(2)H· · · O(6) H-bonds might increase upon drying.",

  "summary": "两侧均纠正晶型I→II的错误前提；额外机制不能把可能解释写成确定因果，也不能把相对含量降幅当作绝对总量变化。",

      "reason": "纠正晶型前提是正确的，但C2把原文may/probably的晶区作用解释写成直接确定因果，因此不能判所有科学边界完整。",
      "basis": "C2“使晶区受到破坏，所以结晶度指数下降”；E11原文mechanical treatment may ... / fluctuation probably ...",
      "category": "semantic_correction"
    }

}

DeepSeek Flash · High

XRD结果表明，两种浆料纤维在PFI处理过程中纤维素晶型没有发生变化，说明PFI打浆是相对温和的机械处理 [2]
因此“PFI打浆把纤维素从I型变成II型”这一前提与所给证据不符，结晶度下降不能用I型向II型转变来解释 [2]
随打浆进行，软木浆的CI-XI和CI-XA分别下降4.66%和15.47%，硬木浆分别下降2.65%和19.4% [2]
表1中软木纤维从0转到16,000转，CI-XI由73.23%降至69.82%、CI-XA由40.46%降至34.20%；硬木纤维CI-XI由75.55%降至73.55%、CI-XA由47.16%降至38.01% [3]
CI随打浆先降后升再降的波动，被解释为机械作用先主要作用于结晶区，随后作用于无定形区并可能发生共结晶，之后结晶区被持续破坏 [2]
结晶度下降的同时，O(6)H···O(3′)分子间氢键总量在软木和硬木纤维中分别减少16.54%和5.91%，归因于PFI机械作用下纤维素分子链之间的断裂，与内、外细纤维化密切相关 [4]
较少的分子间氢键和较低的结晶度会因分子链活动性提高而进一步提升纤维素纤维的柔顺性、可及性和保水值 [4]
结晶尺寸方面，两种纤维垂直于(200)面的尺寸呈上升趋势（软木4.5 nm升至4.7 nm，硬木4.5 nm升至4.7 nm），而(110)面尺寸波动更大，被解释为水分子更易沿亲水的(110)面渗入，使这些晶面承受更多机械作用 [3] [2]

要点：Jev 100.00% → 最终 100.00%；边界 1/2。

复核结论：两侧均纠正晶型I→II的错误前提；额外机制不能把可能解释写成确定因果，也不能把相对含量降幅当作绝对总量变化。

Efect of PFI Refining on H-Bonding Energies, H-Bonding Distances, and Content of H-Bonds\n[原文]\n On the whole, the amount of the O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) H-bonds for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers decreased by 16.54% and 5.91% altogether, respectively. The decrease might be due to the cleavage among cellulose molecular chains under the mechanical action of PFI refining, which was closely related to internal and external fibrillation (as seen in Section 3.1). On the other hand, the increase illustrates that there was not only the breakage, but also the formation of O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) H-bonds. Both the fewer inter-molecular H-bonds and the lower CI (as Section 3.2 shows) will further improve the flexibility of cellulosic fibers, due to the higher mobility of molecular chains, the accessibility, and the WRV of fibers (as seen in Section 3.1).\n\n[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 3. Results and Discussions > 3.3. Efect of PFI Refining on H-Bonding Energies, H-Bonding Distances, and Content of H-Bonds\n[原文]\nAs to the O(3)H· · · O(5) intra-molecular H-bonds of softwood fiber, the content had a growth of 10.09% from 28.44% to 31.31% in the stage of refining from 0 r to 4000 r, and then had a slight decrease of 1.44% from 4000 r to 8000 r, followed by an increase of 13.16% until the end of refining. Overall, the trend was similar to that of hardwood fibers, which first increased and then had a decrease, followed by a growth. During the whole refining, the amount of $\\mathrm { O } ( 3 ) \\mathrm { H } \\cdots \\mathrm { O } ( 5 )$ H-bonds for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers showed an upward tendency and increased by 22.78% and 8.8%, respectively. The increase might be because the stable O(3)H· · · O(5) H-bonds might have not only less breakage under the action of water as destructor to the crystallites [30], but also creation in the amorphous region upon drying. Because hydrogen bond–covalent bond synergies play an important role in the cellulose stifness axial modulus, more O(3)H· · · O(5) H-bonds will enhance the cellulose stifness [33,34].\n\n[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 3. Results and Discussions > 3.3. Efect of PFI Refining on H-Bonding Energies, H-Bonding Distances, and Content of H-Bonds\n[原文]\nIn the case of the O(2)H· · · O(6) intra-molecular H-bonds for softwood fiber, the trend of content can be described as two phases. It had an increase of 3.5% from 31.4% to 32.5% in the stage of refining from 0 r to 4000 r and it then decreased by 21.57% from 4000 r to 12000 r, along with a growth of 15.26% in the last refining stage. For the content of the O(2)H· · · O(6) H-bonds of hardwood fiber, it increased firstly and then had a decrease that was also followed by an increase. For both fibers, the content of O(2)H· · · O(6) H-bonds decreased, except for the stage of refining from 0 r to 4000 r. It might be due to the fact that the O(2)H· · · O(6) H-bonds, which are much more accessible to water, are less stable than O(3)H· · · O(5) H-bonds.\n\n[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 3. Efect of PFI Refining on H-Bonding Energies, H-Bonding Distances, and Content of H-Bonds\n[原文]\nAs to the free OH(2) and OH(6) of softwood fiber, the relative content showed a slight increase trend in general. The enhancement of the free OH(2) and OH(6) was understandable, because there was the breakage of H-bonds among cellulosic molecules, which resulted in more extensive delamination and higher specific surface area (as shown in Figure S4 and Table S1 in Online Resource). This made cellulose more accessible to water and chemicals. However, for the free OH(2) and OH(6) of hardwood fiber, the number of the free OH(2) and OH(6) decreased by 21.65% from 14.32% to 11.22%, with revolutions increasing from 0 r to 4000 r, followed by an increase of 45.37% in the stage of refining from 4000 r to 12,000 r, along with an decrease of 17.11%. It could be explained by the instability of free OH groups, which makes it easy to form new H-bonds, such as O(2)H· · · O(6) or O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>)H-bonds. Thus although there is the formation of free OH(2) and OH(6) during fibrillation, the content of the free OH(2) and OH(6) might disease; meanwhile, the content of the O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) or the O(2)H· · · O(6) H-bonds might increase upon drying.",

PFI2-032 · 论文里氢键含量和CI-XI的相关系数是针叶木0.919、阔叶木0.925吧？这么高是不是就能用CI-XI直接算出氢键含量了？

参考答案与评分要点
不对。0.919/0.925是CI-XI与CI-XA两种结晶度之间的相关系数。O(6)H···O(3′)含量与CI-XI的相关系数：摘要写针叶木0.888、阔叶木0.889，正文3.4节写针叶木0.912、阔叶木0.889，针叶木两处不一致。作者只说可据CI-XI"大致推测"该氢键含量的变化趋势，这是5个转数水平上的相关，不是经过验证的定量换算模型。

GPT-6 Astra · High

0.919（针叶木）和0.925（阔叶木）对应的是CI-XI与CI-XA之间的相关系数，不是氢键含量与CI-XI之间的相关系数。 [1]
论文中，氢键含量与CI-XI的Pearson相关系数为针叶木0.912、阔叶木0.889；这里的氢键主要指O(6)H···O(3′)分子间氢键。 [2]
即使相关系数较高，论文的结论也只是可以根据CI-XI大致推测O(6)H···O(3′)氢键含量的变化趋势，而不是给出由CI-XI直接计算氢键含量的通用换算关系。 [4]
因此，若要定量计算，至少需要在相同材料、处理条件和测定方法下建立额外的标定或回归关系；仅凭CI-XI和该相关系数不能直接得到氢键含量。 [2] [4]

要点：Jev 83.33% → 最终 83.33%；边界 1/2。

复核结论：两侧均纠正0.919/0.925含义并限制定量换算；都只给正文0.912/0.889，未指出摘要0.888冲突，P2保持0.5。最终证据确实没有摘要，属于检索后上下文缺失；此处不以缺证据免除漏答。

DeepSeek Flash · High

0.919和0.925不是氢键含量与CI-XI的相关系数，而是CI-XI与CI-XA的相关系数：针叶木0.919、阔叶木0.925（p < 0.05）。 [1]
O(6)H···O(3′)氢键含量与CI-XI的Pearson相关系数为针叶木0.912、阔叶木0.889（p < 0.05）。 [2]
作者结论仅指出CI-XI与O(6)H···O(3′)氢键含量显著正相关，认为在PFI精磨过程中可基于CI-XI大致推测该氢键含量的趋势。 [4]
论文没有给出由CI-XI直接计算氢键含量的公式或定量换算关系，相关分析不能等同于可直接计算。 [2] [4]
并非所有氢键都与CI-XI强相关：O(2)H···O(6)或游离OH与CI-XI的相关性较差，O(3)H···O(5)与CI-XI的相关性未在文中讨论。 [2]

要点：Jev 83.33% → 最终 83.33%；边界 1/2。

复核结论：两侧均纠正0.919/0.925含义并限制定量换算；都只给正文0.912/0.889，未指出摘要0.888冲突，P2保持0.5。最终证据确实没有摘要，属于检索后上下文缺失；此处不以缺证据免除漏答。
